advancement.singulo.anchor.description.translation: 建立一个小型世界线锚点

advancement.singulo.android_charger.desc.translation: 获得机器人无线充电器

advancement.singulo.android_delivery.des.source: Receive the full requested quantity of an order you placed
advancement.singulo.android_delivery.des.translation: 收到自己订单所需的全部物品

advancement.singulo.android_memory.descr.source: Obtain any ordinary android design memory from a ruin fabricator
advancement.singulo.android_memory.descr.translation: 从遗迹打印台获得任意一种普通型号的设计存储器

advancement.singulo.android_printed.desc.source: Finish printing a guard at your own assembly station
advancement.singulo.android_printed.desc.translation: 在自己的组装站完成一名护卫的打印

advancement.singulo.android_prototypes.d.source: Hold both Alma and Nox design memories together (two Overseer victories guarantee both)
advancement.singulo.android_prototypes.d.translation: 同时持有阿尔玛与诺克斯的设计存储器（击败监督者两次即可集齐）

advancement.singulo.android_recipe.descr.source: Obtain a Recipe Card and record a recipe at the Work Console
advancement.singulo.android_recipe.descr.translation: 获得配方卡，并在作业指令台记录配方

advancement.singulo.android_routes.descr.source: Obtain an Area Card; combine it with location cards to plan routes
advancement.singulo.android_routes.descr.translation: 获得区域卡，配合位置卡规划路径

advancement.singulo.android_station.desc.source: Obtain an Android Assembly Station; prepare a memory, a kit and power
advancement.singulo.android_station.desc.translation: 获得机器人组装站，并准备设计存储器、套件与电力

advancement.singulo.android_work.descrip.source: Obtain a Work Console; connect supplies and recipes
advancement.singulo.android_work.descrip.translation: 获得作业指令台，连接材料仓储并准备配方

advancement.singulo.archivist.descriptio.source: Lay the Last Archivist to rest

advancement.singulo.awakened_foundry.des.translation: 击败觉醒的铸造监督者

advancement.singulo.bose.description.translation: 制作玻色凝聚态催化剂

advancement.singulo.ceramic.description.translation: 烧制白色陶瓷复合材料

advancement.singulo.compass.description.source: Obtain an exploration compass to choose your next expedition
advancement.singulo.compass.description.translation: 获得探索罗盘，选择下一个探索地点

advancement.singulo.compressor.descripti.translation: 建造压缩机。质量模式下什么都能压实

advancement.singulo.echo.description.source: Be a surviving challenger in the arena when the Echo Sentinel falls
advancement.singulo.echo.description.translation: 残响哨兵被击败时，作为存活的挑战者留在战斗区域内

advancement.singulo.foundry.description.source: Be a surviving challenger in the arena when the Foundry Overseer falls
advancement.singulo.foundry.description.translation: 统括AI铸造监督者被击败时，作为存活的挑战者留在战斗区域内

advancement.singulo.genesis_birth.descri.source: Give birth to a universe in the Genesis Engine
advancement.singulo.genesis_birth.descri.translation: 在创世炉中孕育一个宇宙

advancement.singulo.gravity.description.source: Be a surviving challenger in the arena when the Gravity Remnant falls
advancement.singulo.gravity.description.translation: 重力残滓被击败时，作为存活的挑战者留在战斗区域内

advancement.singulo.hawking.description.source: Collect H condensate from a reactor in harvest mode. The first core needs six
advancement.singulo.hawking.description.translation: 从回收模式运行的黑洞中获取霍金凝聚体。第一个奇点核心需要 6 个（直接收集 4 个，复原异常样本得 2 个）

advancement.singulo.lab_power.descriptio.source: Be present when power returns to the underground android laboratory
advancement.singulo.lab_power.descriptio.translation: 在地下机器人研究所恢复供电时身处现场

advancement.singulo.leviathan.descriptio.source: Be a surviving challenger in the arena when the Ergosphere Leviathan falls
advancement.singulo.leviathan.descriptio.translation: 能层巨蛇被击败时，作为存活的挑战者留在战斗区域内

advancement.singulo.projector.descriptio.source: Make a holo projector and use it on a controller
advancement.singulo.projector.descriptio.translation: 制作全息投影仪。对控制器使用即可看到结构形状

advancement.singulo.records.description.translation: 破译每一份古老的记录

advancement.singulo.root.description.source: Extract energy from mass. Open the handbook to begin
advancement.singulo.root.description.translation: 从质量中提取能量。先打开手册吧

advancement.singulo.ruin_android_lab.des.source: Open the cache of the underground android laboratory
advancement.singulo.ruin_android_lab.des.translation: 打开地下机器人研究所的储藏室

advancement.singulo.ruin_culture.descrip.translation: 打开封闭培养设施的保管库

advancement.singulo.ruin_final.descripti.source: After the Gravity Remnant, reach the entrance to the final lab
advancement.singulo.ruin_final.descripti.translation: 跨越重力残滓，抵达最终实验设施的入口

advancement.singulo.ruin_observation.des.translation: 打开地表观测站的保管库

advancement.singulo.ruin_sunken.descript.source: Open the cache of a Sunken Reactor Sector
advancement.singulo.ruin_sunken.descript.translation: 打开沉没的炉心区的保管库

advancement.singulo.star_core.descriptio.translation: 制作人造星核。再也不用去找下界之星了

advancement.singulo.synth_legendary.desc.source: Synthesize a legendary item (rarity 4) in the Genesis Engine
advancement.singulo.synth_legendary.desc.translation: 在创世炉中合成一件传说级物品（稀有度4）

advancement.singulo.thermo.description.source: Build a thermoelectric generator and put it between hot and cold
advancement.singulo.thermo.description.translation: 建造热电发电机。用高温和低温方块夹住它即可发电

advancement.singulo.tower.description.source: Form a cryogenic cooling tower. Recover observation-post materials to make superconducting coils
advancement.singulo.tower.description.translation: 组装低温冷却塔。回收观测站的材料以制作超导线圈

advancement.singulo.warden.description.source: Be a surviving challenger in the arena when the Horizon Warden falls
advancement.singulo.warden.description.translation: 地平线守卫被击败时，作为存活的挑战者留在战斗区域内

advancement.singulo.wormhole.description.source: Connect a pair of wormhole mouths

block.singulo.degenerate_compactor_vent.translation: 简并压缩炉冷却通风口

block.singulo.tipler_holder.translation: 蒂普勒圆柱时间晶体支架

command.singulo.blackhole.done.translation: 已在 %s, %s, %s 生成流浪黑洞 · 质量 %s

compass.singulo.hint.source: Sneak-use on the cache of a cleared %s to tune it for the next ruin
compass.singulo.hint.translation: 潜行右键已攻略的%s的保管库，即可调校以搜寻下一处废墟

compass.singulo.meteor.found.translation: 陨石核心位于 %s 格外

compass.singulo.meteor.idle.source: Right-click to search for a meteorite core

compass.singulo.meteor.mined.source: The meteorite core it pointed to has been mined
compass.singulo.meteor.mined.translation: 所指的陨石核心已被开采

compass.singulo.meteor.not_found.translation: 附近没有尚未开采的陨石核心

compass.singulo.not_cleared.source: Clear %s first by opening its cache
compass.singulo.not_cleared.translation: 请先打开%s的保管库完成攻略

compass.singulo.upgraded.source: Compass tuned: it can now find %s
compass.singulo.upgraded.translation: 罗盘已调校：现在也能搜寻%s

compass.singulo.upgraded_branch.source: Compass tuned: it can now find %s and %s
compass.singulo.upgraded_branch.translation: 罗盘已调校：现在也能搜寻%s和%s

death.attack.singulo.tidal.source: %1$s was torn apart by tidal forces

desc.singulo.accelerator_controller.source: Controls a square ring 8–32 wide. Bigger rings are faster and yield more monopoles.
desc.singulo.accelerator_controller.translation: 控制 8-32 宽的方形环。环越大，速度越快，产生的单极子也越多。

desc.singulo.accelerator_tube.source: Tube segment of the Particle Accelerator ring.

desc.singulo.afterglow_wings.source: Wings of crystal feathers born from the Last Archivist's light. Wear them on your chest to glide; sneak while gliding to beat them and surge ahead. No fall damage.
desc.singulo.afterglow_wings.translation: 由最后的记录者之光诞生的结晶羽翼。穿在胸甲栏即可滑翔，滑翔时潜行会振翅加速。不会受到摔落伤害。

desc.singulo.android_armor_plate.source: One fitted to a guard android works as its chestplate (+8 armor, +2 toughness). Takes armor enchantments.
desc.singulo.android_armor_plate.translation: 装在护卫仿生人身上时作为胸甲生效（护甲 +8，盔甲韧性 +2）。可附上护甲类附魔。

desc.singulo.android_backpack_upgrade.source: Fitted to a guard android, it adds 12 inventory slots (2 rows of 6). The android wears it on its back. Used to make the Reinforced Backpack (18 slots) and the Large Backpack (24 slots).
desc.singulo.android_backpack_upgrade.translation: 装在护卫仿生人上后，物品栏增加 12 格（2 行 6 列）。仿生人会把它背在背上。可用来制作强化背包（18 格）和大型背包（24 格）。

desc.singulo.android_barrier_glass.source: Glass that only androids cannot pass. Players and other creatures go straight through. Joins seamlessly with the same glass next to it.
desc.singulo.android_barrier_glass.translation: 只有仿生人无法通过的玻璃。玩家和其他生物可以直接穿过。与相同的玻璃相邻时会无缝相连。

desc.singulo.android_barrier_glass_patte.source: Patterned glass that only androids cannot pass.
desc.singulo.android_barrier_glass_patte.translation: 只有仿生人无法通过的花纹玻璃。

desc.singulo.android_battery_upgrade.source: Fitted to a guard android, each one raises its full charge by 50% (up to two). A battery pack appears on its waist for each.
desc.singulo.android_battery_upgrade.translation: 装在护卫仿生人上后，每个可使充满电量增加 50%（最多两个）。装了几个，腰部就会出现几个电池包。

desc.singulo.android_beret.source: A beret for an android's head. Goes in the decoration page. Dye it with dyes on a crafting table.
desc.singulo.android_beret.translation: 戴在仿生人头上的贝雷帽。放入装饰页的栏位。可与染料一起在工作台染色。

desc.singulo.android_book.source: A book an android holds while idle. Goes in the decoration page. Dye it with dyes on a crafting table.
desc.singulo.android_book.translation: 待机中的仿生人拿在手上的书。放入装饰页的栏位。可与染料一起在工作台染色。

desc.singulo.android_bouquet.source: A bouquet an android holds while idle. Goes in the decoration page. Dye it with dyes on a crafting table.
desc.singulo.android_bouquet.translation: 待机中的仿生人拿在手上的花束。放入装饰页的栏位。可与染料一起在工作台染色。

desc.singulo.android_cape.source: A cape hanging from an android's shoulders that flutters as it walks. Goes in the decoration page. Dye it with dyes on a crafting table.
desc.singulo.android_cape.translation: 从仿生人肩部垂到背后的披风，行走时会飘动。放入装饰页的栏位。可与染料一起在工作台染色。

desc.singulo.android_capsule.source: A glass capsule holding a dormant white android body.
desc.singulo.android_capsule.translation: 沉睡着白色仿生人素体的玻璃舱。

desc.singulo.android_charger.source: While you carry it, a following android comes close and recharges as it walks with you (30 full charges when full). Right-click a block that supplies power to charge it.
desc.singulo.android_charger.translation: 随身携带时，跟随中的仿生人会靠近你，边跟着走边充电（充满时可充满仿生人 30 次）。右键点击能输出电力的方块为其充电。

desc.singulo.android_delivery_port.source: Androids bring finished orders here (choose it as the destination when ordering). A 27-slot box you can name in its screen; it moves its contents into adjacent chests by itself.
desc.singulo.android_delivery_port.translation: 仿生人把订单的成品送到这里（下单时选为交付目标）。27 格的箱子，可在界面中命名，里面的物品会自动移到相邻的箱子。

desc.singulo.android_dual_tank_upgrade.source: Only works when Mekanism is installed. In the tank slot it gives two liquid tanks and two chemical tanks (16,000 mB each; the same total as a Tank Upgrade), for work that uses both. Glass tubes and gas cylinders show at its waist. It cannot be removed while they hold anything.
desc.singulo.android_dual_tank_upgrade.translation: 仅在安装了 Mekanism 时可用。放入储罐栏后，会装上 2 个液体储罐和 2 个化学品储罐（各 16,000 mB。总量与储罐升级相同）。适合同时使用液体和化学品的作业。腰部会出现玻璃筒和气瓶。储罐内还有内容物时无法取下。

desc.singulo.android_factory_print_unit.source: Fitted in an Android Assembly Station's print unit slot, printing takes half the time and power, and repairs on the station run twice as fast.
desc.singulo.android_factory_print_unit.translation: 装在仿生人组装站的打印单元槽中，打印所需的时间和电力减半，在组装站上的修理速度变为 2 倍。

desc.singulo.android_felling_upgrade.source: Lets a guard android do felling steps on procedure cards (cutting whole trees and replanting saplings), like a diamond axe. Takes Efficiency, Fortune and Silk Touch.
desc.singulo.android_felling_upgrade.translation: 装在护卫仿生人上后，可执行步骤卡的伐木（整棵砍树并补种树苗），相当于钻石斧。可附上效率、时运和精准采集。

desc.singulo.android_gas_tank_upgrade.source: Only works when Mekanism is installed. In the tank slot it gives two tanks for Mekanism chemicals (gases, infuse types, pigments, slurries; 32,000 mB each, one chemical per tank), so work can carry chemicals from the stockpile to machines. Gas cylinders show at its waist. Click a tank in the screen with a chemical tank to fill or draw. It cannot be removed while they hold anything.
desc.singulo.android_gas_tank_upgrade.translation: 仅在安装了 Mekanism 时可用。放入储罐栏后，会装上 2 个能搬运 Mekanism 化学品（气体、灌注物、颜料、浆液）的储罐（各 32,000 mB，每个 1 种）。作业时会把化学品从资材存放处运到装置。腰部会出现气瓶。用化学品储罐等点击界面中的储罐可以取放。储罐内还有内容物时无法取下。

desc.singulo.android_gate_glass.source: Glass that only androids can pass; solid for everything else. Joins seamlessly with the same glass next to it.
desc.singulo.android_gate_glass.translation: 只有仿生人可以通过的玻璃，对其他一切都是实心的。与相同的玻璃相邻时会无缝相连。

desc.singulo.android_gate_glass_patterne.source: Patterned glass that only androids can pass.
desc.singulo.android_gate_glass_patterne.translation: 只有仿生人可以通过的花纹玻璃。

desc.singulo.android_glasses.source: Square glasses for an android, with clear light-blue lenses. Goes in the head slot of the decoration page. Dye the frames with dyes on a crafting table.
desc.singulo.android_glasses.translation: 戴在仿生人眼睛上的方形眼镜（镜片透出淡蓝色）。装在装饰页的头部栏位。可与染料一起在工作台染色（镜框颜色）。

desc.singulo.android_hair_flower.source: A flower hair ornament worn on the right side of an android's head. Goes in the decoration page. Dye it with dyes on a crafting table.
desc.singulo.android_hair_flower.translation: 戴在仿生人头部右侧的花朵发饰。放入装饰页的栏位。可与染料一起在工作台染色。

desc.singulo.android_headdress.source: A frilled headdress for an android's head. Goes in the decoration page. Dye it with dyes on a crafting table.
desc.singulo.android_headdress.translation: 戴在仿生人头上的褶边头饰。放入装饰页的栏位。可与染料一起在工作台染色。

desc.singulo.android_kit.source: A set of parts and shell. An Android Assembly Station uses one each time it prints an android.
desc.singulo.android_kit.translation: 一套零件与外壳。仿生人组装站每打印一个仿生人就消耗一个。

desc.singulo.android_large_backpack_upgr.source: Fitted to a guard android, it adds 24 inventory slots (4 rows of 6), the largest backpack. You can swap it in for a smaller backpack without emptying it.
desc.singulo.android_large_backpack_upgr.translation: 装在护卫仿生人上后，物品栏增加 24 格（4 行 6 列），是最大的背包。不必取出物品就能换下较小的背包。

desc.singulo.android_memory_axe.source: A compact crystal memory holding the design of the Axe Android prototyped in the underground android laboratory. Dropped by the laboratory overseer. Put it in an Android Assembly Station to print that design (it is not used up).
desc.singulo.android_memory_axe.translation: 记录着地下仿生人研究所试制的斧型仿生人设计的小型水晶存储器。击败研究所的统括AI即可获得。放入仿生人组装站后即可打印该型号（不会消耗）。

desc.singulo.android_memory_bit.source: A compact crystal memory holding the design of the Bit Android prototyped in the underground android laboratory. Dropped by the laboratory overseer. Put it in an Android Assembly Station to print that design (it is not used up).
desc.singulo.android_memory_bit.translation: 记录着地下仿生人研究所试制的浮游炮型仿生人设计的小型水晶存储器。击败研究所的统括AI即可获得。放入仿生人组装站后即可打印该型号（不会消耗）。

desc.singulo.android_memory_blade.source: A compact crystal memory with a reader, holding the design of the Blade Android. Put it in an Android Assembly Station to print that design (it is not used up).
desc.singulo.android_memory_blade.translation: 记录了光刃型仿生人设计、带读取端子的小型水晶存储器。放入仿生人组装站即可打印该型号（不会消耗）。

desc.singulo.android_memory_gunner.source: A compact crystal memory holding the design of the Gunner Android. Light keeps flowing through its crystal. Put it in an Android Assembly Station to print that design (it is not used up).
desc.singulo.android_memory_gunner.translation: 记录了射击型仿生人设计的小型水晶存储器。光芒在晶体中不停流动。放入仿生人组装站即可打印该型号（不会消耗）。

desc.singulo.android_memory_saber.source: A compact crystal memory with a reader, holding the design of the Saber Android. Put it in an Android Assembly Station to print that design (it is not used up).
desc.singulo.android_memory_saber.translation: 记录了光剑型仿生人设计、带读取端子的小型水晶存储器。放入仿生人组装站即可打印该型号（不会消耗）。

desc.singulo.android_memory_whip.source: A compact crystal memory with a reader, holding the design of the Whip Android. Put it in an Android Assembly Station to print that design (it is not used up).
desc.singulo.android_memory_whip.translation: 记录了鞭型仿生人设计、带读取端子的小型水晶存储器。放入仿生人组装站即可打印该型号（不会消耗）。

desc.singulo.android_mining_upgrade.source: Fitted to a guard android, it lets the android do mining work (like a diamond pickaxe). Takes Efficiency, Fortune and Silk Touch.
desc.singulo.android_mining_upgrade.translation: 装在护卫仿生人上后，它就能进行采掘作业（相当于钻石镐）。可附上效率、时运和精准采集。

desc.singulo.android_production_upgrade.source: Fitted in an Android Assembly Station, it prints and looks after up to two androids. Only one can charge on top at a time; the other waits beside it and takes its turn.
desc.singulo.android_production_upgrade.translation: 装在仿生人组装站后，最多可打印并管理两个仿生人。一次只能有一个在上方充电，另一个在旁边等待并轮流充电。

desc.singulo.android_recipe_rack.source: A six-row rack. Put a Work Location Card on the left of a row and up to eight recipe cards on the right, and they can be ordered as recipes made at that location.
desc.singulo.android_recipe_rack.translation: 6 行的架子。在每行左边放作业位置卡、右边放最多 8 张配方卡，就能作为在那个位置制作的配方下单。

desc.singulo.android_reinforced_backpack.source: Fitted to a guard android, it adds 18 inventory slots (3 rows of 6). You can swap it in for a smaller backpack without emptying it, since the contents still fit. Used to make the Large Backpack.
desc.singulo.android_reinforced_backpack.translation: 装在护卫仿生人上后，物品栏增加 18 格（3 行 6 列）。内容物装得下，所以不必取出物品就能换下较小的背包。可用来制作大型背包。

desc.singulo.android_repair_kit.source: Kept in a guard android's inventory, one is used to restore half its health when it gets hurt (when they run out, it returns to its station).
desc.singulo.android_repair_kit.translation: 放在护卫仿生人的物品栏里，受伤时会用掉一个，恢复一半生命（用完后返回组装站）。

desc.singulo.android_ribbon.source: A ribbon tied at the back of an android's head. Goes in the decoration page. Dye it with dyes on a crafting table.
desc.singulo.android_ribbon.translation: 系在仿生人后脑的缎带。放入装饰页的栏位。可与染料一起在工作台染色。

desc.singulo.android_scarf.source: A scarf wrapped around an android's neck. Goes in the decoration page. Dye it with dyes on a crafting table.
desc.singulo.android_scarf.translation: 围在仿生人脖子上的围巾。放入装饰页的栏位。可与染料一起在工作台染色。

desc.singulo.android_station.source: Prints one guard android (two with a Production Upgrade) from a compact crystal memory, an android kit and power, and reprints it with a new kit if it falls. Set how it moves and at what health it comes back to repair and recharge.
desc.singulo.android_station.translation: 用小型水晶存储器、仿生人套件和电力打印一个护卫仿生人（有生产升级时最多两个），被击倒后用新的套件重新打印。可设置其行动方式，以及在何种生命值时返回维修与充电。

desc.singulo.android_supply_port.source: Connects the storage next to it (chests and the like) and fluid tanks as the work stockpile. Androids take materials here and put what they make back.
desc.singulo.android_supply_port.translation: 把相邻的存储（箱子等）和流体储罐连接为作业的资材存放处。仿生人在这里取材料，并把做好的物品放回。

desc.singulo.android_tank_upgrade.source: Gives a guard android two tanks for liquids and gases (32,000 mB each, one fluid per tank), so work can carry fluids from the stockpile to machines. The tanks show at its waist. It cannot be removed while they hold anything.
desc.singulo.android_tank_upgrade.translation: 装在护卫仿生人上后，会有 2 个可装液体或气体的储罐（各 32,000 mB，每个储罐一种）。作业时可把流体从资材存放处运到装置。腰部会出现储罐。储罐里还有东西时无法取下。

desc.singulo.android_teacup.source: A teacup an android holds while idle. Goes in the decoration page. Dye it with dyes on a crafting table. Right-click to place it as a cup on a saucer; it keeps its color and comes back when broken.
desc.singulo.android_teacup.translation: 待机的仿生人拿在手中的茶杯。装在装饰页的栏位中。可与染料一起在工作台上染色。右键可将它放置为放在茶碟上的杯子（保留染好的颜色，破坏后会变回物品）。

desc.singulo.android_transfer_upgrade.source: Fitted in an Android Assembly Station's upgrade slot, an android that falls or is dismantled sends its inventory (repair kits, armor plate, upgrades and carried items) to the station instead of dropping it, and the next android it prints carries it.
desc.singulo.android_transfer_upgrade.translation: 装在仿生人组装站的强化栏位后，仿生人倒下或被拆解时，其物品（修理套件、装甲板、升级和携带的物品）不会掉落，而是传送到组装站，并交给下一个打印出的仿生人。

desc.singulo.android_umbrella.source: An umbrella an android holds up while idle. Goes in the decoration page. Dye it with dyes on a crafting table.
desc.singulo.android_umbrella.translation: 待机中的仿生人撑着的伞。放入装饰页的栏位。可与染料一起在工作台染色。

desc.singulo.android_waist_ribbon.source: A large bow tied at the back of an android's waist. Goes in the decoration page. Dye it with dyes on a crafting table.
desc.singulo.android_waist_ribbon.translation: 系在仿生人腰后的大蝴蝶结。放入装饰页的栏位。可与染料一起在工作台染色。

desc.singulo.android_work_console.source: Brings together the supply ports, delivery ports and recipe racks linked to it with a Work Location Card, takes orders and hands the work to nearby androids. It works as a supply port and a delivery port itself, and its Record tab writes recipes onto recipe cards. Orders need every material in stock.
desc.singulo.android_work_console.translation: 汇总用作业位置卡连接的资材口、交付口和配方架，接受订单并把作业分配给附近的仿生人。指令台本身也兼作资材口和交付口，并可在界面的“记录”中把配方记录到配方卡上。材料不足的订单无法下单。

desc.singulo.android_workbench.source: Where androids make crafting-table recipes, four times as fast as a vanilla crafting table. Record it on the Work Location Card in a recipe rack. Crafted items that do not fit in the android's inventory go into its holding box until the android comes back (right-click to take what is left).
desc.singulo.android_workbench.translation: 仿生人制作工作台配方的地方，速度是原版工作台的4倍。将它记录到配方架的作业位置卡上使用。作出的物品装不进仿生人的物品栏时，会放进台上的暂存箱，之后再来取（剩下的物品可以右键取出）。

desc.singulo.archive_terminal.source: Copies ruin records onto data cards, restores degraded parts and decodes crystal memories.
desc.singulo.archive_terminal.translation: 将废墟记录抄写到数据卡上，修复劣化的零件，并读取水晶存储器。

desc.singulo.archivist_halo.source: The halo the Last Archivist wore. It is still quietly warm and faintly whispers in an old tongue.
desc.singulo.archivist_halo.translation: 最后的记录者曾戴着的光环。至今仍静静地温热着，隐约低语着古老的语言。

desc.singulo.area_card.source: Sneak-use two blocks to record the area between them as corners (up to 128 blocks per side; one card is split off a stack). Sneak-use again to record anew; sneak-use on nothing to clear it. Used on the Routes page of the work console and assembly station for the area a waypoint covers and for no-entry zones.
desc.singulo.area_card.translation: 潜行右键两个方块，记录以它们为角的范围（每边最多 128 格。堆叠时只分出一张记录）。再次潜行右键会重新记录。对空处潜行右键会清除记录。用于作业指令台・组装站“路径”的对象范围和禁入区域。

desc.singulo.artificial_star_core.source: A star core that replaces nether stars.
desc.singulo.artificial_star_core.translation: 可替代下界之星的恒星核心。

desc.singulo.awakening_echo_core.source: A sentinel core overlaid with echo-shard records. Use it on the guardian core in a Research Building to call the Awakened Echo Sentinel: 2.5× health, 1.5× damage, faster moves, an extra echo, and it re-projects broken projectors when enraged. Victory adds an overclock chip and more to the usual drops.
desc.singulo.awakening_echo_core.translation: 用回响碎片的记录覆写过的守卫投影核心。在研究楼的守卫封印核心上使用，会召唤觉醒的回响守卫：生命 2.5 倍、伤害 1.5 倍、招式更快、多一个分身，狂暴时会重新投影被破坏的投影器。获胜后除了平常的掉落，还能获得超频芯片等奖励。

desc.singulo.awakening_ergosphere_core.source: A Chapter of the Vortex spun up again with jet condensate and H-Condensate. Use it on the guardian core of a Sunken Reactor Sector to call the Awakened Ergosphere Leviathan: 2.5× health, 1.5× damage, faster swimming, chained dives and a breath that tracks you.
desc.singulo.awakening_ergosphere_core.translation: 用喷流凝聚体和霍金凝聚体重新赋予旋转的漩涡断章。在沉没的炉心区的守卫封印核心上使用，会召唤觉醒的能层巨蛇：生命 2.5 倍、伤害 1.5 倍、游得更快、连续冲撞，漩涡吐息会追踪你。

desc.singulo.awakening_foundry_core.source: Precision actuators charged with singularity power to reawaken the overseer's command chain. Use it on the guardian core in an Android Laboratory to wake the Awakened Foundry: 2.5× health, 1.5× damage, faster moves, and it reprints its broken production lines once when enraged.
desc.singulo.awakening_foundry_core.translation: 向精密致动器注入奇点之力，唤醒统筹 AI 指令系统的核心。在地下仿生人研究所的守卫封印核上使用，觉醒的铸造厂就会醒来。体力 2.5 倍、攻击 1.5 倍，招式间隔更短，进入全力状态时会把被破坏的生产线全部重新打印一次。

desc.singulo.awakening_gravity_core.source: A degenerate nucleus charged with singularity power. Use it on the guardian core in a Culture Facility to call the Awakened Gravity Remnant: 2.5× health, 1.5× damage, more debris, a wider and stronger gravity well, and chained slams. Victory adds an overclock chip and more to the usual drops.
desc.singulo.awakening_gravity_core.translation: 注入了奇点之力的简并核。在封闭培养设施的守卫封印核心上使用，会召唤觉醒的重力残渣：生命 2.5 倍、伤害 1.5 倍、瓦砾更多、重力井更大更强，并会连续砸地。获胜后除了平常的掉落，还能获得超频芯片等奖励。

desc.singulo.awakening_record_core.source: A record of the defeated warden, reforged with singularity power. Use it on the Seal Console in the final lab to wake the Awakened Horizon Warden: 2.5× health, 1.5× damage, faster moves. Victory yields overclock chips and more.
desc.singulo.awakening_record_core.translation: 用奇点之力重铸被击败守卫记录而成的核心。在最终实验室的封印控制台上使用，即可唤醒觉醒的视界守卫：生命 2.5 倍、伤害 1.5 倍、招式更快。获胜可获得超频芯片等奖励。

desc.singulo.basic_circuit.source: An electronic circuit for basic control.
desc.singulo.basic_circuit.translation: 用于基础控制的电子电路。

desc.singulo.basic_frame.source: The frame almost every machine is built on.
desc.singulo.basic_frame.translation: 几乎每台机器都建立在这个框架上。

desc.singulo.bh_container.source: A vessel for holding a tiny black hole.

desc.singulo.bismuth_crystal_block.source: Stepped, rainbow-tarnished crystals grown from molten bismuth. A building block.
desc.singulo.bismuth_crystal_block.translation: 熔化的铋冷却后形成的阶梯状彩虹色晶体。建材。

desc.singulo.bismuth_ingot.source: A metal with an iridescent surface.

desc.singulo.black_hole_bomb.source: Thrown: opens a tiny black hole that swallows its surroundings.
desc.singulo.black_hole_bomb.translation: 投掷后在命中处打开一个小黑洞，吞噬周围的一切。

desc.singulo.black_reinforced_glass.source: See-through, as hard and blast-resistant as the Black Reinforced Panel. Needs an iron pickaxe or better.
desc.singulo.black_reinforced_glass.translation: 可透视，与黑色强化面板一样坚硬且耐爆炸。需要铁镐或更好的镐。

desc.singulo.black_reinforced_panel.source: A black panel as blast-resistant as obsidian. Needs an iron pickaxe or better.
desc.singulo.black_reinforced_panel.translation: 与黑曜石一样耐爆炸的黑色面板。需要铁镐或更好的镐。

desc.singulo.black_star_glass.source: Black Reinforced Glass with a four-pointed star.
desc.singulo.black_star_glass.translation: 带有四芒星图案的黑色强化玻璃。

desc.singulo.blank_data_card.source: An empty card for copying records in the Archive Terminal.
desc.singulo.blank_data_card.translation: 在档案终端中抄写记录用的空白卡。

desc.singulo.blueprint_lab_building.source: Plans for the laboratory white panels, lined panels, floor tiles, frames, glass and power conduits. Found on laboratory supply shelves and in research chests.
desc.singulo.blueprint_lab_building.translation: 研究所白色面板、带纹面板、地砖、结构材、玻璃、动力导管的设计图。可在研究所物资架和研究室收纳中找到。

desc.singulo.blueprint_lab_furniture.source: Plans for desk monitors, coffee makers, vending machines, paper stacks, trash bins, server racks and body capsules. Found in laboratory office, quarters and kitchen storage.
desc.singulo.blueprint_lab_furniture.translation: 桌面显示器、咖啡机、自动售货机、文件堆、垃圾桶、服务器机架、素体胶囊的设计图。可在研究所办公室、个人房间和厨房的收纳中找到。

desc.singulo.blueprint_lighting.source: Plans for ruin lamps (white, amber, verdant, violet and crimson), pristine ruin light panels and the laboratory facility and emergency lights. Found in ruin caches and laboratory supply shelves.
desc.singulo.blueprint_lighting.translation: 遗迹照明（白、琥珀、翠、堇、红）、无瑕遗迹导光板、研究所设施灯与应急灯的设计图。可在遗迹保管库和研究所物资架中找到。

desc.singulo.blueprint_pristine_ruin.source: Plans for flawless pristine ruin panels, tiles and pillars. Found in the caches of research buildings and deeper ruins.
desc.singulo.blueprint_pristine_ruin.translation: 无瑕的遗迹面板、瓷砖、柱子的设计图。可在研究楼及更深处遗迹的保管库中找到。

desc.singulo.blueprint_rayleigh.source: Plans for the Rayleigh sky panel that shows a blue sky on the ceiling. Found in laboratory research chests. The panels in the laboratory ceiling cannot be recovered, so build them from this.
desc.singulo.blueprint_rayleigh.translation: 在天花板上映出蓝天的瑞利散射面板的设计图。可在研究所研究室的收纳中找到。研究所天花板上的面板无法回收，因此要用它来制作。

desc.singulo.blueprint_ruin_glass.source: Plans for ruin glass (broken, intact and reinforced). Found in the caches of research buildings and deeper ruins.
desc.singulo.blueprint_ruin_glass.translation: 遗迹玻璃（破碎、普通、强化）的设计图。可在研究楼及更深处遗迹的保管库中找到。

desc.singulo.blueprint_ruin_panels.source: Plans for the white outer ruin panels (plain, cracked, mossy, tiled, vented, striped and scorched). Found in the caches of observation posts and research buildings.
desc.singulo.blueprint_ruin_panels.translation: 遗迹白色外墙面板（普通、开裂、长苔、瓷砖、通风、带纹、烧焦）的设计图。可在地表观测据点和研究楼的保管库中找到。

desc.singulo.bose_condensate_catalyst.translation: 3级催化剂。比缪子催化剂更强、更持久。

desc.singulo.builder_wand.source: Creative only. Instantly builds the multiblock of a controller. Sneak to change size.
desc.singulo.builder_wand.translation: 仅限创造模式。对控制器使用可立即搭建其多方块结构。潜行可切换尺寸。

desc.singulo.bulkhead.source: A heavy door sealing the laboratory core section. It opens when facility power returns. Unbreakable.
desc.singulo.bulkhead.translation: 封住研究所中枢区的厚门。设施恢复供电后打开。无法破坏。

desc.singulo.canned_soda.source: A blue can of soda from the laboratory's vending machine. Drinking it gives Speed for 2 minutes.
desc.singulo.canned_soda.translation: 研究所自动售货机里的蓝色罐装汽水。饮用后 2 分钟内移动速度提升。

desc.singulo.casimir_cavity.source: Creates negative energy between mirrors to make exotic matter.
desc.singulo.casimir_cavity.translation: 在镜子之间产生负能量以制造奇异物质。

desc.singulo.casimir_cavity_controller.source: Middle of the front, second layer, of the 5×5×5 cavity.
desc.singulo.casimir_cavity_controller.translation: 位于5×5×5空腔正面、从下数第二层的中央。

desc.singulo.casimir_cavity_frame.source: Frame along the cavity edges (not the corners).
desc.singulo.casimir_cavity_frame.translation: 沿空腔各条棱放置的框架（角除外）。

desc.singulo.casimir_cavity_pump.source: Vacuum pumps on the eight corners.
desc.singulo.casimir_cavity_pump.translation: 放在八个角上的真空泵。

desc.singulo.casimir_cavity_shield.source: Magnetic shields either side of each window.
desc.singulo.casimir_cavity_shield.translation: 放在每个窗口两侧的磁屏蔽。

desc.singulo.casimir_cavity_wall.source: Vessel wall; any can be swapped for an I/O port.
desc.singulo.casimir_cavity_wall.translation: 容器壁；任何一个都可以替换为 I/O 端口。

desc.singulo.casimir_cavity_window.source: Middle of each side; shows the vacuum between the mirrors.
desc.singulo.casimir_cavity_window.translation: 位于每个侧面的中央；可看到镜面之间的真空。

desc.singulo.catalyst_stabilizer.source: Use with a catalyst in your other hand to double its remaining life. Once per catalyst.
desc.singulo.catalyst_stabilizer.translation: 另一只手持催化剂时使用，可使其剩余寿命翻倍。每个催化剂仅限一次。

desc.singulo.catalytic_reactor.source: Makes catalysts, starting with the muon catalyst.
desc.singulo.catalytic_reactor.translation: 制造催化剂的装置，缪子催化剂就在这里制作。

desc.singulo.ceramic_substrate.translation: 绝缘性优良的陶瓷基板。

desc.singulo.coffee.source: Coffee from a coffee maker, in a bottle. Drinking it gives Haste for 3 minutes and wakes you up, resetting the time until phantoms appear. The bottle is left over.
desc.singulo.coffee.translation: 用咖啡机冲泡的瓶装咖啡。饮用后 3 分钟内挖掘速度提升，并能提神（重置幻翼出现前的时间）。喝完会留下玻璃瓶。

desc.singulo.coffee_maker.source: The laboratory break-room coffee maker. Add cocoa beans to brew three cups, then fill glass bottles from the pot. The ones in the laboratory already have coffee in them.
desc.singulo.coffee_maker.translation: 研究所茶水间的咖啡机。放入可可豆可冲泡 3 杯咖啡，再用玻璃瓶从壶中盛取。研究所里的咖啡机一开始就已经泡好了咖啡。

desc.singulo.cold_atoms.source: Atoms cooled close to absolute zero.
desc.singulo.cold_atoms.translation: 冷却到接近绝对零度的原子。

desc.singulo.compressed_block_1.source: Nine units of mass pressed together. The start of the compression chain.
desc.singulo.compressed_block_1.translation: 由九个单位的质量压成的方块。压缩链的起点。

desc.singulo.compressed_block_2.source: Nine Lv1 blocks (eight if mixed). Fuel for the Degenerate Furnace.
desc.singulo.compressed_block_2.translation: 九个 Lv1 方块（混合时为八个）。简并热炉的燃料。

desc.singulo.compressed_block_2_mixed.source: Lv1 made from 3+ kinds of blocks needs only 8 for Lv2.
desc.singulo.compressed_block_2_mixed.translation: 由 3 种以上方块制成的 Lv1，只需 8 个即可合成 Lv2。

desc.singulo.compressed_metal_block_1.source: A compressed block made only of metals.
desc.singulo.compressed_metal_block_1.translation: 仅由金属制成的压缩块。

desc.singulo.compressed_metal_block_2.source: Denser metal block, used for artificial star cores.
desc.singulo.compressed_metal_block_2.translation: 较致密的金属块，用于人造星核。

desc.singulo.compressor.source: Presses plates. In mass mode it turns any item into mass for compressed blocks and pellets.
desc.singulo.compressor.translation: 压制板材。在质量模式下可将任何物品转化为质量，压成压缩块和质量颗粒。

desc.singulo.confinement_ring.source: A ring that cages black holes and singularities in a magnetic field, its meteoric-iron core gathering the flux.
desc.singulo.confinement_ring.translation: 用磁场牢笼困住黑洞和奇点的环。陨铁芯负责汇聚磁通。

desc.singulo.control_unit.source: A restored ancient control unit with limited uses.
desc.singulo.control_unit.translation: 修复后的古代控制单元，有使用次数限制。

desc.singulo.coolant_cartridge.source: A canister holding 100 mB of liquid nitrogen. Right-click a machine to pour it in and get the empty cartridge back, so no pipes are needed. Cryogenic Turbines also take it in their input slot. The Precision Assembler uses it as is for cryogenic parts such as quantum computing modules. Assembly consumes the cartridge, including its container; no empty cartridge is returned.
desc.singulo.coolant_cartridge.translation: 装有 100 mB 液氮的容器。右键点击装置即可倒入，并取回空冷媒罐，无需管道。低温涡轮机的入口也接受冷媒罐。精密组装台会将它作为低温部件的材料连同容器一起消耗，不会返还空冷媒罐。

desc.singulo.cooling_tower_base.translation: 冷却塔底部的 5×5 地基。

desc.singulo.cooling_tower_casing.source: Cooling Tower wall. Panels on the 5×5 rings can be swapped for I/O ports.
desc.singulo.cooling_tower_casing.translation: 冷却塔外壁。5×5 环上的外壁可替换为 I/O 端口。

desc.singulo.cooling_tower_controller.source: Goes in the middle of the front, second layer. The tower is 7–15 high; taller is faster.
desc.singulo.cooling_tower_controller.translation: 放在正面中央、第二层。塔高 7–15 格；越高越快。

desc.singulo.cooling_tower_coolant_band.source: Coolant bands around the waist, every third layer.
desc.singulo.cooling_tower_coolant_band.translation: 环绕在塔腰处、每三层一圈的冷却带。

desc.singulo.cooling_tower_extension.source: Build the tower 10+ high to liquefy helium.
desc.singulo.cooling_tower_extension.translation: 将塔建到 10 格以上即可液化氦气。

desc.singulo.cooling_tower_glass.source: Window in the tower waist; the cores glow blue inside.
desc.singulo.cooling_tower_glass.translation: 塔腰处的观察窗；可看到内部的核心发出蓝光。

desc.singulo.cooling_tower_grate.source: Grate closing the top; the vapour escapes through it.
desc.singulo.cooling_tower_grate.translation: 封住塔顶的格栅；蒸汽从这里逸出。

desc.singulo.cooling_tower_rim.source: The 5×5 rim at the top of the tower.

desc.singulo.copper_wire.source: Tier 1 power cable. Loses a little energy over distance.
desc.singulo.copper_wire.translation: 1 级电源线。随着距离的增加会损失一点能量。

desc.singulo.core_controller.source: Placed 5 below the core centre. Ignite the reactor from its screen.
desc.singulo.core_controller.translation: 放在炉心中心正下方 5 格处。从其界面点燃反应堆。

desc.singulo.cosmic_muon_collector.source: Collects cosmic-ray muons for free high up under open sky.
desc.singulo.cosmic_muon_collector.translation: 在高处的露天环境下免费收集宇宙射线缪子。

desc.singulo.creative_catalyst.source: Creative only. A catalyst that never wears out. Right-click to change its tier.
desc.singulo.creative_catalyst.translation: 仅限创造模式。永不损耗的催化剂。右键可切换其等级。

desc.singulo.creative_energy_source.source: Creative only. Endless power pushed into every neighbour.
desc.singulo.creative_energy_source.translation: 仅限创造模式。无限的电力，会推送给每个相邻方块。

desc.singulo.cryogenic_cooling_tower.source: A multiblock that liquefies nitrogen from the air, and helium too once it is 10 or more blocks tall.
desc.singulo.cryogenic_cooling_tower.translation: 从空气中制造液氮的多方块结构；塔高 10 以上时还能将氦液化为液氦。

desc.singulo.cryogenic_turbine.source: Recovers the power stored in liquid nitrogen by boiling it against a heat source next to it (up to 90% next to lava). It stores and moves power; it does not create any.
desc.singulo.cryogenic_turbine.translation: 利用旁边的高温源使液氮汽化，取回储存在液氮中的电力（在熔岩旁最多 9 成）。这是用来储存和运送电力的装置，不会增加电力。

desc.singulo.culture_data.translation: 旧文明留下的培养实验记录。

desc.singulo.data_card_observation_log.source: A copy of an observation log, usable in recipes.
desc.singulo.data_card_observation_log.translation: 观测日志的副本，可用于配方。

desc.singulo.data_card_quantum_fragment.source: A copy of a quantum data fragment.

desc.singulo.decoded_record.source: Right-click to read it and add the next ancient record to your handbook.
desc.singulo.decoded_record.translation: 右键单击即可阅读它，并将下一个古代记录添加到您的手册中。

desc.singulo.deep_sea_collector.source: On the sea floor, water pressure presses minerals into Pressure Crystals. Works from 16 blocks deep; fastest at 48 (one a minute). No power needed.
desc.singulo.deep_sea_collector.translation: 放在海底时，上方的水压会把矿物压成高压晶体。水深 16 格以上运转，48 格时最快（每分钟 1 个）。不需要电力。

desc.singulo.degenerate_compactor.source: Crushes matter into degenerate shells and reactor parts.
desc.singulo.degenerate_compactor.translation: 将物质压至简并，制成简并物质壳和反应堆部件。

desc.singulo.degenerate_compactor_anvil.source: The anvil at the centre of the Degenerate Compactor floor. It takes the blows of the ram from above.
desc.singulo.degenerate_compactor_anvil.translation: 放在简并压缩炉底面中心的砧座，承受上方压头的撞击。

desc.singulo.degenerate_compactor_contro.source: Middle of the front, second layer, of the 5×5×5 press.
desc.singulo.degenerate_compactor_contro.translation: 位于 5×5×5 压机正面、第二层的中央。

desc.singulo.degenerate_compactor_frame.source: Frame along the 12 edges of the press.
desc.singulo.degenerate_compactor_frame.translation: 沿压机 12 条棱放置的框架。

desc.singulo.degenerate_compactor_plate.source: Plating; any plate can be swapped for an I/O port.
desc.singulo.degenerate_compactor_plate.translation: 外装甲板；任何一块都可替换为 I/O 端口。

desc.singulo.degenerate_compactor_ram.source: Top centre; hammers down onto the anvil.
desc.singulo.degenerate_compactor_ram.translation: 位于顶部中心；向下锤击砧座。

desc.singulo.degenerate_compactor_vent.source: Cooling vents along the top row of each side.
desc.singulo.degenerate_compactor_vent.translation: 每侧顶排都有冷却通风口。

desc.singulo.degenerate_compactor_window.source: Middle of each side; watch the ram strike.
desc.singulo.degenerate_compactor_window.translation: 位于每个侧面的中央；可观看压头的撞击。

desc.singulo.degenerate_furnace.source: A large generator burning Lv2 blocks: 5 MFE/t on time crystals with default settings (25% on BE catalysts).
desc.singulo.degenerate_furnace.translation: 燃烧 Lv2 块的大型发电机。默认设置下使用时间晶体催化剂为 5 MFE/t（低一级的 玻色凝聚态催化剂为 25%）。

desc.singulo.degenerate_furnace_controll.source: Goes in the middle of a side, second layer from the bottom.
desc.singulo.degenerate_furnace_controll.translation: 位于一侧的中间，从底部算起的第二层。

desc.singulo.degenerate_furnace_fin.source: Radiators on either side of each furnace window.
desc.singulo.degenerate_furnace_fin.translation: 每个炉窗两侧都有散热器。

desc.singulo.degenerate_furnace_frame.source: The heavy frame along the 12 edges of the 5×5×7 furnace.
desc.singulo.degenerate_furnace_frame.translation: 沿着 5×5×7 熔炉的 12 个边缘的重型框架。

desc.singulo.degenerate_furnace_piston.source: Sits in the middle of the top and bottom faces and crushes the fuel.
desc.singulo.degenerate_furnace_piston.translation: 位于顶面和底面的中间并压碎燃料。

desc.singulo.degenerate_furnace_shell.source: Furnace plating. Any panel can be swapped for a Multiblock I/O Port.
desc.singulo.degenerate_furnace_shell.translation: 熔炉外壳。任何外壳板都可替换为多方块输入输出端口。

desc.singulo.degenerate_furnace_tube.source: Copper pipes standing in the four inner corners of the furnace.
desc.singulo.degenerate_furnace_tube.translation: 铜管竖立在炉子的四个内角。

desc.singulo.degenerate_furnace_window.source: The middle column of each furnace side; shows the glowing core.
desc.singulo.degenerate_furnace_window.translation: 位于熔炉每个侧面中央的一列；可看到发光的炉心。

desc.singulo.degenerate_matter_shell.source: A dense shell of neutron-star matter.
desc.singulo.degenerate_matter_shell.translation: 由中子星物质构成的致密外壳。

desc.singulo.degenerate_nucleus.source: The uncollapsed gravity knot left at the heart of the Gravity Remnant. Used for the Singularity Encapsulator, Singularity Seed and Graviton Manipulator.
desc.singulo.degenerate_nucleus.translation: 重力残渣核心中残留的、未完全坍缩的重力团块。用于奇点封装器、奇点种子和引力子操控器。

desc.singulo.degenerate_precursor.source: Compressed blocks pressed to the edge of degeneracy around a pressure-crystal seed. Shells need less rock with it.
desc.singulo.degenerate_precursor.translation: 以高压晶体为种，把压缩块 Lv2 压到接近简并的状态。用于简并物质壳时可以减少岩石用量。

desc.singulo.degraded_anomaly_sample.source: A gravitational-anomaly sample altered by time.
desc.singulo.degraded_anomaly_sample.translation: 历经岁月而变质的引力异常样本。

desc.singulo.degraded_cold_atom_trap.source: Restore it in the Laser Cooler.
desc.singulo.degraded_cold_atom_trap.translation: 可在激光冷却器中复原。

desc.singulo.degraded_control_unit.source: An ancient control unit worn by time.
desc.singulo.degraded_control_unit.translation: 历经岁月而损坏的旧文明控制装置。

desc.singulo.degraded_time_crystal_seed.source: A crystal seed destabilized by long dormancy.
desc.singulo.degraded_time_crystal_seed.translation: 因长期休眠而变得不稳定的晶核。

desc.singulo.desk_monitor.source: A small monitor from a laboratory desk. Only its screen glows faintly.
desc.singulo.desk_monitor.translation: 研究所桌上的小显示器。只有屏幕微微发光。

desc.singulo.dimensional_pocket.source: Right-click to open your own 27-slot storage from anywhere. The contents survive death.
desc.singulo.dimensional_pocket.translation: 右键即可随时随地打开专属的 27 格收纳空间。死亡后内容也不会消失。

desc.singulo.dormant_singularity_seed.source: Guarded by the Horizon Warden. Awaken it in the encapsulator.
desc.singulo.dormant_singularity_seed.translation: 由视界守卫守护。在奇点封装器中将其唤醒。

desc.singulo.echo_chapter.source: A passage of records left behind when the Awakened Echo Sentinel unravels. It looks like part of a page. Bound with other chapters, it might be readable.
desc.singulo.echo_chapter.translation: 觉醒的回响守卫消散后留下的一段记录。似乎是某一页的一部分。与其他断章合在一起，或许就能读懂。

desc.singulo.echo_projector.source: Projects the Echo Sentinel. The more projectors remain, the less damage the sentinel takes. Breaks by hand.
desc.singulo.echo_projector.translation: 投射出回响守卫身影的底座。剩下的投影器越多，守卫受到的伤害越少。徒手也能破坏。

desc.singulo.echo_resonator.source: Copies echo shards using a template shard.
desc.singulo.echo_resonator.translation: 以回响碎片为模板进行复制。

desc.singulo.electrolyzer.source: Splits water into hydrogen and oxygen.
desc.singulo.electrolyzer.translation: 将水分解成氢气和氧气。

desc.singulo.emergency_light.source: Laboratory emergency light. It glows red only while main power is down.
desc.singulo.emergency_light.translation: 研究所的应急灯。只在主电源断开时亮起红光。

desc.singulo.empty_coolant_cartridge.source: A steel canister that holds 100 mB of liquid nitrogen. Right-click the cooling tower controller, or process it in the tower, to fill it.
desc.singulo.empty_coolant_cartridge.translation: 可装 100 mB 液氮的钢制容器。用它右键点击极低温冷却塔的控制器，或在冷却塔中加工，就会变成装满的冷媒罐。

desc.singulo.energy_drink.source: A yellow can of energy drink from the laboratory's vending machine. Drinking it gives Haste II for 2 minutes.
desc.singulo.energy_drink.translation: 研究所自动售货机里的黄色罐装饮料。饮用后 2 分钟内挖掘速度大幅提升（急迫 II）。

desc.singulo.entangled_element.source: A pair of elements with entangled quantum states.
desc.singulo.entangled_element.translation: 量子态彼此纠缠的一对元件。

desc.singulo.entanglement_synthesizer.translation: 成对产生量子纠缠元件。

desc.singulo.ergosphere_chapter.source: A passage of records that surfaces after the Ergosphere Leviathan sinks: the rest of the second reactor's log. Also used for the Awakened Ergosphere Core.
desc.singulo.ergosphere_chapter.translation: 能层巨蛇沉入漩涡后浮现的一段记录：第二座反应堆运行记录的后续。也用于觉醒涡核。

desc.singulo.ergosphere_ring.source: Extracts exotic matter from a fast-spinning core.
desc.singulo.ergosphere_ring.translation: 从高速自旋的炉心中提取奇异物质。

desc.singulo.event_horizon_shield.source: Protects a 32-block radius from explosions, griefing and hostile spawns.
desc.singulo.event_horizon_shield.translation: 保护 32 格半径范围内免受爆炸、破坏和敌对生成的影响。

desc.singulo.exotic_matter.source: Matter with negative energy density. Fuels gravity tech.
desc.singulo.exotic_matter.translation: 具有负能量密度的物质。为重力技术提供燃料。

desc.singulo.explorer_compass.source: Right-click to point at the nearest ruin of the chosen kind. Sneak-use to change the kind.
desc.singulo.explorer_compass.translation: 右键指向所选类型中最近的废墟。潜行使用可切换类型。

desc.singulo.extraction_port.source: Power/fuel port for the reactor. Replaces any ring shell block (not the gyro drives).
desc.singulo.extraction_port.translation: 反应堆的电力/燃料端口。可替换环上任意外壳方块（陀螺驱动装置除外）。

desc.singulo.facility_light.source: Laboratory ceiling light. It shines white only while the facility has power.
desc.singulo.facility_light.translation: 研究所的天花板照明。只在设施有电时发出白光。

desc.singulo.factory_conveyor.source: A belt conveyor from an old-civilization factory. While running, it carries whatever stands on it. The Foundry Overseer runs them during its fight.
desc.singulo.factory_conveyor.translation: 旧文明工厂的皮带传送带。运转时会把站在上面的东西运走。废弃仿生人工厂的铸造厂只在战斗期间让它运转。

desc.singulo.factory_line.source: A printing bay along the walls of the Android Laboratory AI core. While running it shields the Foundry Overseer and prints mass-produced androids. Breakable by hand.
desc.singulo.factory_line.translation: 排列在地下仿生人研究所 AI 中枢墙边的打印舱。运转期间会保护铸造厂，并打印量产型仿生人送出来。徒手也能破坏。

desc.singulo.fluid_canister.source: Holds up to 1,000 mB of any liquid or gas. Right-click a machine to fill it from the output tank or pour it into the input tank. Carries hydrogen (Electrolyzer to Particle Accelerator), helium (Compressor to Cooling Tower) and liquid helium without pipes.
desc.singulo.fluid_canister.translation: 可装入任意液体或气体，最多 1,000 mB。右键机器时，会从输出储罐中灌装，或倒入输入储罐。无需流体管道即可搬运氢气（电解槽→粒子加速器）、氦气（压缩机→冷却塔）和液氦。

desc.singulo.focusing_magnet.source: Magnet for the ring corners and at least 1/4 of the ring.
desc.singulo.focusing_magnet.translation: 放在环的四角，且至少占环的 1/4 的磁体。

desc.singulo.fulgurite.source: Natural high-purity quartz glass fused by lightning. Used to make optical lattice substrates.
desc.singulo.fulgurite.translation: 被闪电熔化后凝固的高纯度天然石英玻璃。用于制作光晶格基板。

desc.singulo.fulgurite_block.source: Sand fused by a lightning strike. Break it for fulgurite.
desc.singulo.fulgurite_block.translation: 被闪电击中瞬间熔化凝固的沙子。破坏后掉落闪电熔岩。

desc.singulo.genesis_core.source: The heart of an engine that makes a universe from energy. Surround it with 8 frames and 12 pylons, use a Primordial Seed and pour in 1.5 TFE to begin. Once born, the universe turns power into mass (items).
desc.singulo.genesis_core.translation: 从能量中孕育宇宙之炉的核心。用8个框架和12根支柱（4根×3层）围住它，使用原初之种并注入 1.5 TFE，宇宙便开始诞生。诞生后的宇宙能将电力转化为质量（物品）。

desc.singulo.genesis_frame.source: Placed level with the Genesis Core in an octagon three blocks out (four on the axes, four on the 2-2 diagonals).
desc.singulo.genesis_frame.translation: 与创世炉核心放在同一高度，排成距核心3格的八边形（十字方向4个，斜向各2格处4个）。

desc.singulo.genesis_pylon.source: Stacked three high on each diagonal frame of the Genesis Engine; they focus power into the newborn universe.
desc.singulo.genesis_pylon.translation: 在创世炉的每个斜向框架上叠放3层，将电力汇聚并送入将生未生的宇宙。

desc.singulo.glowing_bismuth_crystal.source: Bismuth crystal mixed with phosphor so it glows. A building block.
desc.singulo.glowing_bismuth_crystal.translation: 掺入荧光体而会发光的铋晶体。建材。

desc.singulo.gravitational_containment_t.source: The only tank that holds dark matter. Keeps its contents when broken.
desc.singulo.gravitational_containment_t.translation: 唯一能储存暗物质的储罐。破坏后保留内容物。

desc.singulo.gravitational_wave_detector.source: Points toward the nearest gravitational anomaly.

desc.singulo.graviton_manipulator.source: The full gravity tool. Hold left-click to use; while levitating, charge with right-click and release to throw.
desc.singulo.graviton_manipulator.translation: 完整版重力工具。按住左键使用；悬浮物体时，按右键蓄力，松开即可投掷。

desc.singulo.gravity_boots.source: No fall damage. Jump while touching a wall in mid-air to kick off it (three times before landing).
desc.singulo.gravity_boots.translation: 免疫摔落伤害。在空中贴着墙跳跃即可蹬墙再跳（落地前最多三次）。

desc.singulo.gravity_chapter.source: A passage of records left in the collapse of the Awakened Gravity Remnant, etched with a memory of weight. Bound with other chapters, it might be readable.
desc.singulo.gravity_chapter.translation: 觉醒的重力残渣坍缩后留下的一段记录，刻着关于重量的记忆。与其他断章合在一起，或许就能读懂。

desc.singulo.gravity_field_stabilizer.source: A component that suppresses gravitational fluctuations.
desc.singulo.gravity_field_stabilizer.translation: 抑制引力场波动的部件。

desc.singulo.gravity_panel_receiver.source: Powers every gravity panel connected to it. When power runs short, only the nearest panels it can pay for work. Right-click to see how many are active.
desc.singulo.gravity_panel_receiver.translation: 为与其相连的所有重力面板供电。电力不足时，只有它能负担的最近的面板会工作。右键查看正在工作的数量。

desc.singulo.guardian_core.source: The seal in the floor of a ruin boss room. It wakes the ruin's guardian when a challenger enters. Unbreakable.
desc.singulo.guardian_core.translation: 埋在废墟首领房间地板中的封印。挑战者进入房间时，会唤醒该废墟的守卫。无法破坏。

desc.singulo.gyro_drive.source: Placed where the reactor rings cross.
desc.singulo.gyro_drive.translation: 放置在反应堆环交叉的地方。

desc.singulo.halo_collector.source: Gathers dark matter near a running core.
desc.singulo.halo_collector.translation: 在运行中的炉心附近收集暗物质。

desc.singulo.handbook.source: Right-click to open. Explains goals, machines, multiblocks and shows your progress.
desc.singulo.handbook.translation: 右键打开。介绍目标、机器、多方块结构，并显示你的进度。

desc.singulo.hawking_collector.source: Collects one H-Condensate every 5 minutes while the core is light (catalyst mode; harvest mode keeps it there).
desc.singulo.hawking_collector.translation: 炉心质量较小时（催化剂模式；开启回收运转即可保持），每5分钟收集1个霍金凝聚体。

desc.singulo.hawking_condensate.translation: 汇聚霍金辐射的凝聚体。

desc.singulo.heat_exchange_core.source: Heat exchangers stacked up the middle of the tower.
desc.singulo.heat_exchange_core.translation: 堆叠在塔中央的热交换器。

desc.singulo.high_gravity_panel.source: When powered, standing on it raises your gravity 2.5x until you next land. Joins visually with its neighbours.
desc.singulo.high_gravity_panel.translation: 通电时，站在上面会使你的重力变为 2.5 倍，直到下次着地。外观会与相邻的面板相连。

desc.singulo.holo_projector.source: Use on a multiblock controller to project its shape and list missing blocks. Sneak-use to change size.
desc.singulo.holo_projector.translation: 对多方块控制器使用，可投影其形状并列出缺少的方块。潜行使用可切换尺寸。

desc.singulo.horizon_bus.source: The tier 5 cable, needed to ignite the reactor.
desc.singulo.horizon_bus.translation: 点燃反应堆所需的 5 级电缆。

desc.singulo.horizon_chapter.source: A passage of records found in the Awakened Horizon Warden's wreck, naming what the warden was guarding. Bound with other chapters, it might be readable.
desc.singulo.horizon_chapter.translation: 在觉醒的视界守卫残骸中找到的一段记录，写着守卫所守护之物的名字。与其他断章合在一起，或许就能读懂。

desc.singulo.hydrogen_fuel_cell.source: A stage 1 generator that makes power from hydrogen and oxygen. It returns 60% of the power the Electrolyzer put into the hydrogen: 4.8 FE per mB, up to 240 FE/t, using 1 mB of oxygen per 2 mB of hydrogen. Right-click with an empty hand to see its status.
desc.singulo.hydrogen_fuel_cell.translation: 用氢和氧发电的第 1 阶段发电机。它是取回电解槽灌入氢中的电力的 6 成的储能装置：每 mB 氢 4.8 FE，最大 240 FE/t。每 2 mB 氢使用 1 mB 氧。空手右键可显示状态。

desc.singulo.impact_generator_panel.source: Landing on it causes no fall damage. Stores 1,000 FE per block fallen (up to 20,000 FE) and powers connected gravity panels.
desc.singulo.impact_generator_panel.translation: 落在上面不会受到摔落伤害。每下落 1 格储存 1,000 FE（最多 20,000 FE），并为相连的重力面板供电。

desc.singulo.inertial_control_gauntlet.source: Hold right-click to levitate or pull one small mob. Sneak-use to switch modes.
desc.singulo.inertial_control_gauntlet.translation: 按住右键单击可悬浮或拉动一个小生物。潜行使用来切换模式。

desc.singulo.inertial_stabilizer.source: Stops explosions from breaking blocks within 16 blocks.
desc.singulo.inertial_stabilizer.translation: 使 16 格范围内的爆炸不再破坏方块。

desc.singulo.intact_ruin_glass.source: An intact ancient window, as tough and blast-resistant as a ruin panel.
desc.singulo.intact_ruin_glass.translation: 完好保存的古代窗户，与废墟面板一样坚固且耐爆炸。

desc.singulo.jet_collector.source: Collects jet condensate from the reactor.
desc.singulo.jet_collector.translation: 从反应堆中收集喷流凝聚体。

desc.singulo.jet_condensate.source: Condensed particles from a relativistic jet.
desc.singulo.jet_condensate.translation: 汇聚相对论性喷流粒子的凝聚体。

desc.singulo.keraunos_tower.source: Builds up 1,000,000 FE and hurls artificial lightning at the nearest lightning rod within 16 blocks. Sand under the rod turns into fulgurite. Three firing modes: manual, redstone and auto (sneak-right-click to switch).
desc.singulo.keraunos_tower.translation: 蓄积 1,000,000 FE 后制造人工闪电，射向 16 格内最近的避雷针。避雷针下方的沙子会变成闪电熔岩块。有手动、红石、自动三种发射模式（潜行右键切换）。

desc.singulo.kiln.source: Fires ceramics and boards. Oxygen makes it hotter.
desc.singulo.kiln.translation: 烧制陶瓷和基板。通入氧气可提高温度。

desc.singulo.lab_door.source: The white twin sliding doors of the laboratory's private rooms and kitchen. Right-click to slide them open into the walls; they close by themselves once no one is passing through. They stay open while powered by redstone. Cannot be crafted.
desc.singulo.lab_door.translation: 研究所单间和厨房的白色双扇推拉门。右键点击后会滑入左右墙内打开，没有人通过时会自动关闭。接收到红石信号时保持打开。无法合成。

desc.singulo.lab_frame.source: Dark steel framing used for the laboratory's pillars and door frames.
desc.singulo.lab_frame.translation: 用于研究所柱子和门框的深色钢结构材。

desc.singulo.lab_glass.source: Clear partition glass from the laboratory.
desc.singulo.lab_glass.translation: 研究所隔断用的透明玻璃。

desc.singulo.lab_panel.source: White wall panelling from the underground android laboratory. The androids still polish it spotless.
desc.singulo.lab_panel.translation: 地下仿生人研究所的白色墙材。仿生人至今仍在擦拭，一尘不染。

desc.singulo.lab_panel_lined.source: Laboratory panelling with a blue-grey band.
desc.singulo.lab_panel_lined.translation: 带有青灰色条纹的研究所墙材。

desc.singulo.lab_rayleigh_panel.source: A sky projection panel in the laboratory ceiling. Once facility power returns, its underside shows a cloudless midday sky and lights the space below like sunlight (daylight detectors underneath read midday). Panels side by side join into one wide sky. Leaves nothing when broken.
desc.singulo.lab_rayleigh_panel.translation: 研究所天花板上的天空投影板。设施电力恢复后，底面会映出无云的正午蓝天，并像阳光一样照亮正下方（正下方的阳光探测器始终输出正午的数值）。并排放置会连成一片宽广的天空。破坏后什么也不会留下。

desc.singulo.lab_terminal.source: A terminal left in the laboratory. Use it to read the records left behind.
desc.singulo.lab_terminal.translation: 研究所里留下的终端。右键可以阅读留下的记录。

desc.singulo.laser_cooler.source: Laser-cools atoms into cold atoms, lattices and condensates.
desc.singulo.laser_cooler.translation: 激光将原子冷却成冷原子、晶格和凝聚体。

desc.singulo.low_gravity_panel.source: When powered, standing on it cuts your gravity to a fifth until you next land (less fall damage too). Joins visually with its neighbours.
desc.singulo.low_gravity_panel.translation: 通电时，站在上面会使你的重力降为五分之一，直到下次着地（摔落伤害也会减少）。外观会与相邻的面板相连。

desc.singulo.magnetic_bottle.source: A bottle that traps strangelets in a magnetic field. Use it on leaking strange matter to contain and collect it.
desc.singulo.magnetic_bottle.translation: 用磁场捕获奇异子的瓶子。对泄漏的奇异夸克物质块使用，即可将其封存并回收。

desc.singulo.magnetic_key.source: Opens or seals a magnetic-lock container. Used up each time.
desc.singulo.magnetic_key.translation: 用于打开或封印磁力锁容器。每次使用都会消耗。

desc.singulo.magnetic_monopole.source: A theoretical particle born in about 1 of 1000 collisions.
desc.singulo.magnetic_monopole.translation: 理论上存在的粒子，大约每 1000 次碰撞诞生 1 次。

desc.singulo.mass_pellet.source: Packed mass fuel for the P-Reactor.
desc.singulo.mass_pellet.translation: 压实的质量燃料，供彭罗斯反应堆使用。

desc.singulo.meteor_compass.source: Right-click to point at the nearest meteorite core not yet mined. Once that core is mined, the needle spins again.
desc.singulo.meteor_compass.translation: 右键指向最近的尚未开采的陨石核心。所指的核心被开采后，指针会重新旋转。

desc.singulo.meteoric_iron_chunk.source: Natural iron-nickel alloy inside a meteorite. Mine it (iron pickaxe or better) for raw meteoric iron. Found only in meteor craters.
desc.singulo.meteoric_iron_chunk.translation: 陨石中的铁镍天然合金。用铁镐或更好的镐开采可得到粗陨铁。只在陨石坑中出现。

desc.singulo.meteoric_iron_ingot.source: A naturally magnetic alloy of iron and nickel.
desc.singulo.meteoric_iron_ingot.translation: 具有强磁性的天然铁镍合金。

desc.singulo.meteorite_core.source: A fused lump of meteoric iron and stardust, one at the heart of each meteorite. Mine it (iron pickaxe or better) for raw meteoric iron and stardust. The Meteor Compass points to it.
desc.singulo.meteorite_core.translation: 陨铁与星尘熔合而成的块体，每块陨石的中心各有一个。用铁镐或更好的镐开采，可同时得到粗陨铁和星尘。陨石罗盘指向它。

desc.singulo.meteorite_crust.source: The burnt, melted shell of a crater meteorite. Only shells still in their crater slowly grow stardust clusters.
desc.singulo.meteorite_crust.translation: 包裹陨石坑中心陨石的、被烧熔的黑色外壳。只有原本就在陨石坑里的熔壳会慢慢长出星尘晶簇。

desc.singulo.metric_drive.source: Switch between low gravity, flight and high gravity.
desc.singulo.metric_drive.translation: 在低重力、飞行和高重力之间切换。

desc.singulo.micro_black_hole.source: Holds a tiny black hole. Bends light around it.
desc.singulo.micro_black_hole.translation: 封存着一个微小黑洞。会使周围的光线弯曲。

desc.singulo.mirror_plate.source: Inner 3×3 of the cavity top and bottom: two facing mirrors.
desc.singulo.mirror_plate.translation: 放在空腔顶面和底面内侧的 3×3，构成两面相对的镜子。

desc.singulo.monopole_upgrade.source: Insert into a machine's monopole slot: ×2 speed and 50% better power efficiency.
desc.singulo.monopole_upgrade.translation: 插入机器的单极子插槽：速度 ×2，电力效率提高 50%。

desc.singulo.multiblock_port.source: Replaces a plain shell panel of a multiblock (not frames or functional parts; for the accelerator, either side of the controller). Cables and pipes reach the controller, and outputs and generated power are pushed out automatically.
desc.singulo.multiblock_port.translation: 替换多方块结构的普通外壳面板（框架和功能部件除外；加速器则为控制器两侧）。连接的电缆和管道会直通控制器，产物和发出的电力会自动向外推送。

desc.singulo.muon_bundle.source: A bundle of muons, the base of muon catalysts.
desc.singulo.muon_bundle.translation: 一束缪子，缪子催化剂的原料。

desc.singulo.muon_catalyst.source: Tier 2 catalyst with a lifetime. Leaves a spent catalyst when used up.
desc.singulo.muon_catalyst.translation: 有使用寿命的 2 级催化剂。用完后会留下失活的催化剂。

desc.singulo.muon_fusion_reactor.source: A stage 2 generator that runs on muon catalysts and water (deuterium), 4 kFE/t. Catalysts wear twice as fast: a fresh one lasts 10 minutes, a used one for half its remaining lifetime, then comes out spent.
desc.singulo.muon_fusion_reactor.translation: 用缪子催化剂和水（氘）发电的第 2 阶段发电机（4 kFE/t）。催化剂消耗速度为 2 倍，新的催化剂可运转 10 分钟（用过的只运转剩余寿命的一半），之后变为失活的缪子催化剂。

desc.singulo.neutrino_observatory.source: Keeps scanning a wide area and shows ores and ruins to nearby players. Use to toggle.
desc.singulo.neutrino_observatory.translation: 持续扫描大范围区域，向附近玩家显示矿石和废墟。使用可切换显示。

desc.singulo.neutrino_scanner.source: Shows the outlines of nearby ruin blocks and ores through terrain for 10 seconds. Uses power. Sensitivity modules reveal deeper ores.
desc.singulo.neutrino_scanner.translation: 使用后，在 10 秒内透过地形显示周围的废墟方块和矿石轮廓。消耗电力。更深层的矿石需要灵敏度模块才能显示。

desc.singulo.nihonium_frame.source: A sturdy frame clad in nihonium.

desc.singulo.nihonium_ingot.source: A heavy, dense ingot of nihonium.

desc.singulo.nihonium_plate.source: Nihonium pressed into a thin plate.

desc.singulo.observation_log.source: Observation records left by the old civilization.
desc.singulo.observation_log.translation: 旧文明留下的观测记录。

desc.singulo.optical_lattice_substrate.source: A substrate of atoms arranged in an optical lattice.
desc.singulo.optical_lattice_substrate.translation: 将原子排列在光晶格中的基板。

desc.singulo.overclock_chip.source: Goes in a machine's upgrade slot: ×3 speed for ×4 power per tick. Cannot be combined with a monopole.
desc.singulo.overclock_chip.translation: 放入机器的升级槽：速度 ×3，但每 tick 耗电 ×4。不能与单极子同时使用。

desc.singulo.paper_stack.source: Papers left piled on a desk.
desc.singulo.paper_stack.translation: 堆在桌上没人管的文件。

desc.singulo.particle_accelerator.source: Collides particles into muon bundles and rare monopoles.
desc.singulo.particle_accelerator.translation: 通过粒子碰撞制造缪子束和稀有的磁单极子。

desc.singulo.peltier_cooler.source: Runs current through thermoelectric elements to freeze water (a thermoelectric generator in reverse). 1,000 mB of water makes 1 ice.
desc.singulo.peltier_cooler.translation: 给热电元件通电使水结冰的装置（热电发电机的反向）。1,000 mB 水可制成 1 个冰。

desc.singulo.penrose_reactor.source: Draws energy from a spinning black hole.
desc.singulo.penrose_reactor.translation: 从旋转的黑洞中汲取能量。

desc.singulo.phase_sync_plate.source: A component that synchronizes atomic oscillations.
desc.singulo.phase_sync_plate.translation: 使原子振动同步的部件。

desc.singulo.power_conduit.source: A conduit carrying power from the central reactor. It glows cyan once power returns.
desc.singulo.power_conduit.translation: 从中央动力炉向设施输送电力的导管。恢复供电后会发出青光。

desc.singulo.precision_actuator.source: A precision drive unit of the old civilization.
desc.singulo.precision_actuator.translation: 旧文明的精密驱动部件。

desc.singulo.precision_assembler.source: Assembles most parts and machines from tier 2 on.
desc.singulo.precision_assembler.translation: 组装第 2 阶段以后的大部分零件和机器。

desc.singulo.pressure_crystal.source: A hard blue crystal formed under high water pressure.
desc.singulo.pressure_crystal.translation: 在高水压下形成的坚硬蓝色晶体。

desc.singulo.pressure_hull.source: The two-block-thick steel shell around the laboratory's rooms and corridors. Sealed and unbreakable until the overseer AI falls, and harder than obsidian even after.
desc.singulo.pressure_hull.translation: 包裹研究所房间和走廊的、厚度为 2 格的钢外壳。在统筹 AI 倒下之前处于封锁状态，无法破坏。之后也比黑曜石更硬。

desc.singulo.primordial_seed.source: A seed made by running the ignition log in the Chapter of the Vortex backwards. Use it on a Genesis Core to begin the birth of a universe.
desc.singulo.primordial_seed.translation: 依照漩涡断章中刻下的最初运行记录，将点火步骤逆向追溯而制成的种子。对创世炉核心使用，宇宙便开始诞生。

desc.singulo.pristine_ruin_light.source: A white panel with a softly glowing strip. Very hard; needs an iron pickaxe or better.
desc.singulo.pristine_ruin_light.translation: 带有柔和发光条的白色面板。非常坚硬；需要铁镐或更好的镐。

desc.singulo.pristine_ruin_panel.source: An unweathered white panel from deep ruins. Very hard; needs an iron pickaxe or better.
desc.singulo.pristine_ruin_panel.translation: 来自深层废墟、未经风化的白色面板。非常坚硬；需要铁镐或更好的镐。

desc.singulo.pristine_ruin_pillar.source: A white pillar from deep ruins. Very hard; needs an iron pickaxe or better.
desc.singulo.pristine_ruin_pillar.translation: 来自深层废墟的白色柱子。非常坚硬；需要铁镐或更好的镐。

desc.singulo.pristine_ruin_tiles.source: Unweathered white tiles from deep ruins. Very hard; needs an iron pickaxe or better.
desc.singulo.pristine_ruin_tiles.translation: 来自深层废墟、未经风化的白色瓷砖。非常坚硬；需要铁镐或更好的镐。

desc.singulo.probe_station.source: Sends probes to discovered ruins to fetch loot.
desc.singulo.probe_station.translation: 向已发现的废墟派遣探测器，取回战利品。

desc.singulo.procedure_card.source: Records up to eight steps and what they produce, in the procedure mode of a work console's Record tab. Steps can insert, extract, mine, harvest, fell, breed, shear, milk, cull or use a block (levers and buttons). The places are stored on the card, so it works in a recipe rack row without a Work Location Card. Mining needs a Mining Upgrade and felling a Felling Upgrade.
desc.singulo.procedure_card.translation: 在作业指令台“记录”的步骤模式中，记录最多8个步骤及其产物。步骤有放入、取出、采掘、收获、伐木、繁殖、剪毛、挤奶、处理、操作（拉杆或按钮）。位置记录在卡中，因此可放在配方架中没有作业位置卡的行。采掘需要采掘升级，伐木需要伐木升级。

desc.singulo.quantum_computing_module.source: A computing module that uses quantum states.
desc.singulo.quantum_computing_module.translation: 利用量子态进行运算的模块。

desc.singulo.quantum_data_fragment.source: A fragment of quantum-state analysis data.
desc.singulo.quantum_data_fragment.translation: 量子态分析记录的片段。

desc.singulo.quantum_heat_engine.source: Generates power from the quantum effects of a catalyst. Higher-tier catalysts give more output.
desc.singulo.quantum_heat_engine.translation: 利用催化剂的量子效应发电。催化剂等级越高，输出越大。

desc.singulo.quantum_key.source: Opens or seals a quantum-lock container. Used up each time.
desc.singulo.quantum_key.translation: 用于打开或封印量子锁容器。每次使用都会消耗。

desc.singulo.raw_meteoric_iron.source: Raw meteoric metal containing iron and nickel.
desc.singulo.raw_meteoric_iron.translation: 含有铁和镍的陨石原矿。

desc.singulo.rayleigh_panel.source: A sky projection panel for ceilings. Fed FE (20 FE/t), its underside shows a midday sky with no clouds or sun and lights the space below like sunlight (light level 15; daylight detectors underneath read midday). It never turns to night; without power it is dark as midnight. Panels side by side lose their edges and join into one wide sky. Made from the Rayleigh Sky Panel Blueprint.
desc.singulo.rayleigh_panel.translation: 贴在天花板上的天空投影板。输入FE（20 FE/t）后，底面会映出没有云和太阳的正午蓝天，并像阳光一样照亮正下方（亮度15，正下方的阳光探测器始终输出正午的数值）。不会变成夜晚。断电后像午夜一样漆黑。并排放置时边框会消失，连成一片宽广的天空。用瑞利散射面板的设计图制作。

desc.singulo.reactor_console.source: Central reactor control panel. Use it to restart the reactor and restore facility power.
desc.singulo.reactor_console.translation: 中央动力炉的控制台。右键启动动力炉后，设施将恢复供电。

desc.singulo.reactor_core.source: The central reactor core. It glows bright cyan once power returns.
desc.singulo.reactor_core.translation: 中央动力炉的炉心。恢复供电后会发出强烈的青光。

desc.singulo.reactor_mass_alarm.source: Replaces a shell on a reactor ring. Emits redstone when the core reaches its mass limit, stronger near collapse.
desc.singulo.reactor_mass_alarm.translation: 替换反应堆环上的外壳方块。炉心达到质量上限时发出红石信号，越接近坍缩信号越强。

desc.singulo.reactor_shell.source: Shell of the reactor's three rings.
desc.singulo.reactor_shell.translation: 构成反应堆三个圆环的外壳。

desc.singulo.reactor_stabilizer.source: Coils at the 45° points of the reactor rings.
desc.singulo.reactor_stabilizer.translation: 放在反应堆圆环 45° 位置的线圈。

desc.singulo.recipe_card.source: Record a recipe on it in a work console's Record tab and place it in a recipe rack. Sneak-use on nothing to clear it. Hold Shift to see what it makes.
desc.singulo.recipe_card.translation: 在作业指令台的“记录”中记录配方，然后放进配方架。对着空处潜行右键会清除配方。按住 Shift 会显示制作的物品。

desc.singulo.record_fragment.source: A storage medium with records etched in glass by light.
desc.singulo.record_fragment.translation: 以光在玻璃内部刻录信息的存储介质。

desc.singulo.reinforced_ruin_glass.source: A window set into the containment pillars of the Sunken Reactor Sector, built to survive the reactor's blasts. Very hard and blast-proof.
desc.singulo.reinforced_ruin_glass.translation: 嵌在沉没的炉心区封锁柱上的窗，用来承受反应炉的冲击。非常坚硬，爆炸也无法破坏。

desc.singulo.relocation_wrench.source: Sneak-use to relocate processing machines, generators, energy storage and catalyst devices with their items, fluids, energy and settings.
desc.singulo.relocation_wrench.translation: 潜行使用可迁移加工装置、发电机、储能装置及催化装置，并保留物品、流体、电力和设置。

desc.singulo.ruin_android_fabricator.source: Prints androids onto its bed and sends them out. Defeat them all for a 50% chance at a compact crystal memory of their design.
desc.singulo.ruin_android_fabricator.translation: 在台面上打印仿生人并让其出动。全部击败后，有一半的几率得到对应型号的小型水晶存储器。

desc.singulo.ruin_cache.source: Holds ruin loot and refills some days after it is emptied (not if moved). Hoppers and pipes cannot take from it.
desc.singulo.ruin_cache.translation: 存放废墟回收物的保管库。清空数天后内容会恢复（被移动过的不会）。漏斗和管道无法从中取出物品。

desc.singulo.ruin_glass.source: A cracked ancient window, as tough and blast-resistant as a ruin panel.
desc.singulo.ruin_glass.translation: 碎裂后残留下来的古代窗户，与废墟面板一样坚固且耐爆炸。

desc.singulo.ruin_lamp.source: An ancient lamp that still glows.
desc.singulo.ruin_lamp.translation: 古老的灯，至今仍闪烁着光芒。

desc.singulo.ruin_lamp_amber.source: An amber ancient lamp found in sealed containers.
desc.singulo.ruin_lamp_amber.translation: 在封印容器中发现的琥珀色古代灯。

desc.singulo.ruin_lamp_crimson.source: A crimson ancient lamp found in sealed containers.
desc.singulo.ruin_lamp_crimson.translation: 在封印容器中发现的深红色古代灯。

desc.singulo.ruin_lamp_verdant.source: A green ancient lamp found in sealed containers.
desc.singulo.ruin_lamp_verdant.translation: 在封印容器中发现的绿色古代灯。

desc.singulo.ruin_lamp_violet.source: A violet ancient lamp found in sealed containers.
desc.singulo.ruin_lamp_violet.translation: 在封印容器中发现的紫色古代灯。

desc.singulo.scanner_module_2.source: Use with a Neutrino Scanner in your other hand, or on an observatory, to reach sensitivity 2: gold, diamond and emerald show up.
desc.singulo.scanner_module_2.translation: 另一只手持中微子扫描仪时使用，或对观测站使用，可将灵敏度提升到 2：金、钻石、绿宝石也会显示。

desc.singulo.scanner_module_3.source: Raises sensitivity to 3: ancient debris and ores that need a diamond pickaxe show up.
desc.singulo.scanner_module_3.translation: 将灵敏度提升到 3：远古残骸和需要钻石镐的矿石也会显示。

desc.singulo.scorched_ruin_panel.translation: 被烟灰熏黑的古建筑板材。

desc.singulo.seal_console.source: The seal of the Final Lab. Touch it to wake the Horizon Warden.
desc.singulo.seal_console.translation: 最终实验室的封印。触碰它即可唤醒视界守卫。

desc.singulo.sealed_container_1.source: Opens with a Magnetic Key; sneak-use a key to seal it again. Breaking it by force destroys the contents.
desc.singulo.sealed_container_1.translation: 用磁力锁钥匙打开；潜行时使用钥匙可再次封印。强行破坏会连同内容物一起失去。

desc.singulo.sealed_container_2.source: Opens with a Quantum Key; sneak-use a key to seal it again. Breaking it by force destroys the contents.
desc.singulo.sealed_container_2.translation: 用量子锁钥匙打开；潜行时使用钥匙可再次封印。强行破坏会连同内容物一起失去。

desc.singulo.sealed_container_3.source: Opens with a Temporal Key; sneak-use a key to seal it again. Breaking it by force destroys the contents.
desc.singulo.sealed_container_3.translation: 用时间锁钥匙打开；潜行时使用钥匙可再次封印。强行破坏会连同内容物一起失去。

desc.singulo.sealed_container_4.source: Opens with a Singularity Key; sneak-use a key to seal it again. Breaking it by force destroys the contents.
desc.singulo.sealed_container_4.translation: 用奇点锁钥匙打开；潜行时使用钥匙可再次封印。强行破坏会连同内容物一起失去。

desc.singulo.sealed_record.source: Right-click to read it and add a sealed ancient record to your handbook.
desc.singulo.sealed_record.translation: 右键阅读，即可将一份被封印的古代记录加入手册。

desc.singulo.sentinel_core.source: The record crystal from the Echo Sentinel's chest. Built into the Echo Resonator, Time Crystal Incubator and Probe Station.
desc.singulo.sentinel_core.translation: 回响守卫胸口的记录晶体。用于回响共鸣器、时间晶体育成槽和自动探测站。

desc.singulo.server_rack.source: A laboratory server. Its lights blink while powered.
desc.singulo.server_rack.translation: 研究所的服务器。有电时指示灯会闪烁。

desc.singulo.settings_card.source: Copies machine side and auto-eject settings, plus the recipe choice between machines of the same type. For a P-Reactor, copies the spin target and feed interval.
desc.singulo.settings_card.translation: 复制并粘贴机器各面和自动排出的设置。同种机器之间还会复制配方选择。用于彭罗斯反应堆时，复制目标自旋和投料间隔。

desc.singulo.shield_permit.source: Put it in a shield tower: only registered players may build, break or take items inside. In an Android Assembly Station, registered players may also control the android, and the android attacks anyone not registered. Use to register yourself; use on a player to register them and you. Anyone can break the emitter crown.
desc.singulo.shield_permit.translation: 放入盾塔后，只有已登记的玩家才能在护盾内建造、破坏或拿取物品。放入仿生人组装站后，已登记的人也能操作仿生人，未登记的人会遭到仿生人攻击。使用可登记自己；对其他玩家使用可登记对方和自己。发射冠任何人都能破坏。

desc.singulo.shield_tower_body.source: Corners of the 3×3 body and the base of the spire.
desc.singulo.shield_tower_body.translation: 3×3 塔身的四角以及尖塔的底部。

desc.singulo.shield_tower_coil.source: Inner 3×3 of the upper plinth layer.

desc.singulo.shield_tower_core.source: The brain of the Event Horizon Shield Tower. Goes in the front middle of the second plinth layer.
desc.singulo.shield_tower_core.translation: 事件视界护盾塔的核心。放在底座第二层正面的中央。

desc.singulo.shield_tower_crown.source: The top of the tower; the dome is cast from here.
desc.singulo.shield_tower_crown.translation: 塔顶；护盾穹顶从这里展开。

desc.singulo.shield_tower_plinth.source: The 5×5 two-layer plinth; its upper edge takes I/O ports.
desc.singulo.shield_tower_plinth.translation: 5×5 的两层底座；上层边缘可替换为 I/O 端口。

desc.singulo.shield_tower_waveguide.source: Middle of each body face and midway up the spire; shows the rising energy.
desc.singulo.shield_tower_waveguide.translation: 塔身各面的中央以及尖塔中段；可看到上升的能量。

desc.singulo.singularity_key.source: Opens or seals a singularity-lock container. Used up each time.
desc.singulo.singularity_key.translation: 用于打开或封印奇点锁容器。每次使用都会消耗。

desc.singulo.singularity_seed.source: Becomes a black hole core when ignited.
desc.singulo.singularity_seed.translation: 被点燃后成为黑洞核心。

desc.singulo.smes_cell.source: Superconducting magnetic energy storage that holds a large amount of power. Right-click to open its screen.
desc.singulo.smes_cell.translation: 超导磁储能装置，可储存大量电力。右键打开界面。

desc.singulo.spent_bose_condensate_catal.source: A Bose condensate catalyst that has lost its activity.
desc.singulo.spent_bose_condensate_catal.translation: 已失去活性的玻色凝聚催化剂。

desc.singulo.spent_muon_catalyst.source: A muon catalyst that has lost its activity.
desc.singulo.spent_muon_catalyst.translation: 已失去活性的缪子催化剂。

desc.singulo.spent_singularity_core.source: A used-up Singularity Core. About 25% can be recovered as a lower-tier catalyst.
desc.singulo.spent_singularity_core.translation: 用尽的奇点核心。约 25% 可回收为低一级的催化剂。

desc.singulo.spent_time_crystal_catalyst.source: A time crystal catalyst that has lost its activity.
desc.singulo.spent_time_crystal_catalyst.translation: 已失去活性的时间晶体催化剂。

desc.singulo.sports_drink.source: A white can of sports drink from the laboratory's vending machine. Drinking it gives Regeneration for 15 seconds.
desc.singulo.sports_drink.translation: 研究所自动售货机里的白色罐装饮料。饮用后 15 秒内持续恢复生命值。

desc.singulo.stardust.source: Cosmic grains carrying rare isotopes. The raw material for cold atoms.
desc.singulo.stardust.translation: 从宇宙带来的微粒，含有地球上没有的稀有同位素。是冷原子的原料。

desc.singulo.stardust_cluster.source: Crystals of cosmic grains that grow on meteorite crust. Break them for stardust.
desc.singulo.stardust_cluster.translation: 长在陨石熔壳上的宇宙微粒晶体。破坏后掉落星尘。

desc.singulo.steel_blend.source: A blend of iron and carbon.
desc.singulo.steel_blend.translation: 铁与碳混合而成的钢铁原料。

desc.singulo.steel_plate.source: Steel pressed into a thin plate.

desc.singulo.strange_matter.source: Ultra-dense matter left by strangelets. Worth 100 mass and usable for degenerate shells.
desc.singulo.strange_matter.translation: 奇异子留下的超致密物质。价值 100 质量，可用于简并物质壳。

desc.singulo.strangelet.source: Converts nearby blocks into strange matter. Contain it with a Magnetic Bottle.
desc.singulo.strangelet.translation: 将附近的方块转化为奇异夸克物质块。用磁瓶收容它。

desc.singulo.striped_ruin_panel.source: Ancient panel with a long-dead light band.
desc.singulo.striped_ruin_panel.translation: 留有早已熄灭的光带的古建筑板材。

desc.singulo.superconducting_coil.source: A coil with zero electrical resistance.

desc.singulo.superconducting_wire.translation: 用于线圈和电缆的电线。

desc.singulo.survey_glasses.source: Worn on the head (use it, or put it in the helmet slot). While worn, the places recorded on the area card or work location card in your hand are outlined (with only the first corner of an area recorded, the area up to the block you look at is previewed). The icons over working androids, showing what they are doing, are only visible while wearing them.
desc.singulo.survey_glasses.translation: 戴在头上（右键，或放入头盔栏）。戴着时，手中范围卡・作业位置卡记录的地点会以框线显示（范围卡只记录了第一个角时，还会预览到所看方块为止的范围）。作业中仿生人头上表示当前动作的标记，也只有戴着时才能看到。

desc.singulo.temporal_key.source: Opens or seals a temporal-lock container. Used up each time.
desc.singulo.temporal_key.translation: 用于打开或封印时间锁容器。每次使用都会消耗。

desc.singulo.terminus_record.source: The four chapters bound back together with singularity power: the last page. Use it on the Seal Console of the Final Lab to wake what slept in the time field. Leave and the record is returned.
desc.singulo.terminus_record.translation: 用奇点之力把四段断章重新装订成的最后一页。在最终实验室的封印控制台上使用，在时间场中沉睡的某物将会醒来。离开房间时记录会返还。

desc.singulo.thermocouple_module.source: An element that converts heat differences into power.
desc.singulo.thermocouple_module.translation: 将温差转化为电力的元件。

desc.singulo.thermoelectric_generator.source: Place it between something hot and something cold to generate power. Your first generator. Magma block + blue ice gives about 76 FE/t without melting.
desc.singulo.thermoelectric_generator.translation: 将其放在热的东西和冷的东西之间即可发电。你的第一台发电机。岩浆块＋蓝冰不会融化，约 76 FE/t。

desc.singulo.tiled_ruin_panel.translation: 铺有细小瓷砖的古建筑板材。

desc.singulo.time_crystal_catalyst.source: Tier 4 catalyst used by most advanced devices.
desc.singulo.time_crystal_catalyst.translation: 4 级催化剂，大多数高级设备都靠它运转。

desc.singulo.time_crystal_incubator.source: Grows time crystal catalysts. Underpowering lowers their purity.
desc.singulo.time_crystal_incubator.translation: 培育时间晶体催化剂。电力不足会降低其纯度。

desc.singulo.time_crystal_module.translation: 封存时间晶体振动的部件。

desc.singulo.time_crystal_seed.translation: 时间晶体催化剂的种子。

desc.singulo.tipler_bearing.source: Top and bottom centre; carries the cylinder axle.
desc.singulo.tipler_bearing.translation: 位于顶部和底部中心；承载圆柱的轴。

desc.singulo.tipler_core.source: Middle of the front, second layer, of the 5×5×9 housing.
desc.singulo.tipler_core.translation: 位于 5×5×9 外壳正面、第二层的中央。

desc.singulo.tipler_cylinder.source: Speeds up time within 16 blocks: machines and crops nearby run twice as fast.
desc.singulo.tipler_cylinder.translation: 加速周围的时间，使 16 格范围内的装置和作物以 2 倍速运转。

desc.singulo.tipler_frame.source: Frame along the 12 edges of the housing.
desc.singulo.tipler_frame.translation: 沿外壳 12 条棱放置的框架。

desc.singulo.tipler_holder.source: Either side of each window, middle layer.
desc.singulo.tipler_holder.translation: 每个窗口两侧，位于中间层。

desc.singulo.tipler_housing.source: Housing; any panel can be swapped for an I/O port.
desc.singulo.tipler_housing.translation: 外壳；任何外壳板都可替换为 I/O 端口。

desc.singulo.tipler_window.source: Five-high slit in each side; shows the spinning cylinder.
desc.singulo.tipler_window.translation: 每个侧面中央 5 格高的竖窗；可看到旋转的圆柱。

desc.singulo.trash_bin.source: A laboratory trash bin. The androids empty it every day.
desc.singulo.trash_bin.translation: 研究所的垃圾桶。仿生人每天都会把它倒空。

desc.singulo.unfired_ceramic.source: Clay, sand, Nether quartz and bone meal (or limestone powder), ready to be fired into white ceramic.
desc.singulo.unfired_ceramic.translation: 粘土、沙子、下界石英和骨粉（或石灰粉），准备烧成白色陶瓷。

desc.singulo.unstable_wormhole_mouth.translation: 若 60 秒内未被稳定就会坍缩。

desc.singulo.vending_machine.source: A laboratory drinks vending machine (two blocks tall). Hold emeralds and press the button under a column to buy Canned Soda (1), Sports Drink (1) or Energy Drink (2). The ones in the laboratory start working once facility power is restored.
desc.singulo.vending_machine.translation: 研究所的饮料自动售货机（2 格高）。手持绿宝石按下正面某一列的按钮，即可购买罐装汽水（1）、运动饮料（1）或能量饮料（2）。研究所里的售货机在设施恢复供电后开始运转。

desc.singulo.vented_ruin_panel.translation: 带通风口的古建筑板材。

desc.singulo.void_collector.source: Place it in the End over open void to gather one Void Dust a minute. Needs no power.
desc.singulo.void_collector.translation: 在末地放在正下方直到虚空都空无一物的地方，每分钟收集 1 个虚空之尘。不需要电力。

desc.singulo.void_dust.source: Dust condensed from the fluctuations of empty space, gathered only above the End void. Steadies space in singularity tech.
desc.singulo.void_dust.translation: 只有在末地虚空上方才能收集到、由空间本身的涨落凝成的尘埃。在奇点技术中用来稳定空间。

desc.singulo.welded_hatch.source: Steel plates welded shut over the lab's supply shaft. Sealed until the lab's AI is defeated; after that it can be mined with a diamond pickaxe.
desc.singulo.welded_hatch.translation: 封住研究所搬运竖井的焊接钢板舱盖。在统括 AI 被打倒之前处于封锁状态，无法破坏。之后可以用钻石镐挖掘。

desc.singulo.white_ceramic_composite.source: The white ceramic used for casings and circuit boards.
desc.singulo.white_ceramic_composite.translation: 用于外壳和电路板的白色陶瓷。

desc.singulo.white_glass_panel.source: A see-through panel in the White Panel style.
desc.singulo.white_glass_panel.translation: 与白色面板同系列的可透视面板。

desc.singulo.white_light_panel.source: A white panel that glows brightly (light 15).
desc.singulo.white_light_panel.translation: 明亮发光的白色面板（亮度 15）。

desc.singulo.white_panel.source: A clean, seamless white panel for your own buildings.
desc.singulo.white_panel.translation: 可以自己制作的干净无缝白色面板，用于你自己的建筑。

desc.singulo.white_sliding_door.source: White twin sliding doors modeled on the laboratory doors. Right-click to slide them open; they close by themselves once no one is passing through, and stay open while powered by redstone. Set into a wall, the doors slide away inside it.
desc.singulo.white_sliding_door.translation: 仿照研究所的门制作的白色双扇推拉门。右键点击后向左右滑开，没有人通过时会自动关闭，接收到红石信号时保持打开。嵌在墙中放置时，门扇会收进墙里。

desc.singulo.white_star_glass_panel.source: A see-through white panel with a four-pointed star.
desc.singulo.white_star_glass_panel.translation: 带有四芒星图案的可透视白色面板。

desc.singulo.work_location_card.source: Sneak-use on a block to record its position (one card is split off a stack). Sneak-use on nothing to clear it. Use a card holding a work console on a supply port, delivery port or recipe rack to link it. Hold Shift to see the recorded block.
desc.singulo.work_location_card.translation: 潜行右键方块来记录其位置（叠在一起时只分出一张来记录）。对着空处潜行右键会清除记录。用记录了作业指令台的卡右键资材口、交付口或配方架即可连接。按住 Shift 会显示记录的方块。

desc.singulo.worldline_anchor_advanced.source: Advanced chunk loader. Embedding a Singularity Core makes it free and maximal.
