In creative mode, /singulo build <name> [size] builds it in one go.
guide.singulo.multiblocks.projector.body.translation:
1. 放置控制器（正面朝向自己，结构向其后方延伸）。
2. 用全息投影仪右键控制器，正确的形状会投影出来，所需数量和缺少的数量会显示在聊天栏。
3. 在青色框中放置所示方块，移除红色框中的方块。全部就位后投影消失，接缝处闪过光芒，装置启动。
4. 可选尺寸的装置（冷却塔、加速器）潜行使用投影仪即可切换尺寸。
创造模式下可用 /singulo build <名称> [尺寸] 一次建成。

guide.singulo.power.cables.body.source:
Copper wire (2 kFE/t, with losses) → superconducting cable (1 MFE/t) → topological wire (100 MFE/t) → horizon bus (no limit; up to about 2.1 GFE/t per machine from other mods). Each route is limited by its lowest-capacity cable; unrelated branches do not lower that limit. Transfers sharing a cable share its per-tick capacity.
Sources nearer to the receiver along the cables supply power first; more distant sources cover the deficit. Equal distances use a stable coordinate order. An empty nearby source or a bottleneck on its route does not block the backup sources. Breaking a cable immediately clears the glow of that wiring.
guide.singulo.power.cables.body.translation:
铜导线（2 kFE/t，有损耗）→ 超导电缆（1 MFE/t）→ 拓扑导线（100 MFE/t）→ 视界总线（无上限；向其他模组的装置每台最多约 2.1 GFE/t）。每条路径的传输量由该路径中容量最低的线缆决定，不受其他分支的限制。经过同一线缆的多次传输共享每刻容量。
按线缆路径到受电装置的距离，优先使用较近的电源，不足部分由较远的电源补充。距离相同时按固定坐标顺序处理。近处电源已空或其路径容量不足时，也会由其他电源补足。切断线缆后，该线路的发光会立即消失。

guide.singulo.power.relocation.body.source:
Craft a Relocation Wrench from 3 steel ingots, 2 copper ingots and a basic circuit. Sneak-use it to pack processing machines, conventional generators, SMES and catalyst devices. Items, fluids, energy, progress and side settings are restored on placement. A full inventory drops one packed device on the ground.
For multiblocks only the controller is packed; the surrounding parts stay in place. Rebuild the structure after moving it. P-Reactors, wormhole devices and android facilities are not supported.
guide.singulo.power.relocation.body.translation:
用3个钢锭、2个铜锭和1个基础电路制作迁移扳手。潜行使用可回收加工装置、常规发电机、SMES及催化装置，并在重新放置时恢复物品、流体、电力、进度和侧面设置。背包已满时会掉落1个已打包的装置。
多方块结构只回收控制器，周围部件留在原处；迁移后需重新组装。彭罗斯反应堆、虫洞装置及仿生人设施等不在支持范围内。

guide.singulo.power.sides.body.source: Use the Sides button in an ordinary processing machine screen to set each face to off / input / output / both, with optional auto-eject. The master auto-eject switch defaults off; turn it on to push through output-capable faces with auto-eject enabled. Hover a face to see its adjacent block. Multiblocks use designated I/O ports; the P-Reactor uses Extraction Ports. Machines that output two gases, such as the electrolyzer, have a tab for each gas. The power button stops a machine, and machines that can make something from power alone have a switch to skip those recipes.
guide.singulo.power.sides.body.translation: 使用普通加工机屏幕中的“侧面”按钮将每个面设置为关闭/输入/输出/两者，并可选择自动排出。多块使用指定的 I/O 端口； 彭罗斯反应堆 使用提取端口。输出两种气体的装置（如电解槽）可为每种气体单独设置输出面。电源按钮可让装置停止；能仅靠电力制造产物的装置有开关，可跳过这些配方。 自动排出的总开关默认关闭；开启后，会从允许自动排出的输出面向相邻方块搬出。将鼠标悬停在一个面上可查看相邻方块的名称。

guide.singulo.power.wormhole.body.source: The only wireless link. Generate a pair of mouths, stabilize them within 60 s using exotic matter and a mouth casing, then carry one away and place it. A port within 8 blocks of a mouth links to the port with the same number (0-127, set with the seven circles in its screen) near the twin mouth, joining power, items and fluids. Each mouth runs 8, 32 or 128 ports depending on its throat size, nearest first, and active ports glow. Throughput also grows with the throat and is unlimited at 7x7. Mouths run on exotic matter and close when it runs out; a newly placed mouth stays open for 5 minutes without fuel.
guide.singulo.power.wormhole.body.translation: 唯一的无线连接。生成一对入口，在 60 秒内用奇异物质和入口外壳将其稳定，然后带走其中一个并放置。入口 8 格内的端口会与另一端入口附近编号相同（0-127，在界面中用 7 个圆圈设定）的端口相连，直接连通电力、物品和液体。每个入口按喉部大小可让 8、32 或 128 个端口工作，按距离由近到远，工作中的端口会发光。可传输的量也随喉部变大，7×7 时不受上限限制。入口以奇异物质维持，耗尽时会关闭；新放置的入口无需燃料也会保持开启 5 分钟。

guide.singulo.romance.darkmatter.body.source: A Halo Collector placed within 16 blocks of a core collects it. It leaks from ordinary containers, so keep it in a Gravitational Containment Tank. Fed directly into the core, it becomes mass without the Eddington limit.
guide.singulo.romance.darkmatter.body.translation: 把晕收集器放在炉心 16 格以内即可收集。它会从普通容器中泄漏，因此要存放在引力约束罐中。直接投入炉心时，不受爱丁顿极限限制即可成为质量。

guide.singulo.romance.gear.body.source:
- Metric Drive: keep it in your inventory and switch between low gravity, zero gravity (flight) and high gravity.
- Graviton Manipulator: levitate, pull, repel and crush. The G key switches to a cone area.
- Advanced Worldline Anchor: with a core embedded, it keeps a radius of 5 loaded with no upkeep.
guide.singulo.romance.gear.body.translation:
- 度规驱动器：放在物品栏中，在低重力、无重力（飞行）和高重力之间切换。
- 引力子操控器：悬浮、牵引、斥力、压溃。按 G 键切换为锥形范围。
- 世界线锚（高级）：嵌入核心后无需消耗即可保持半径 5 的区块加载。

guide.singulo.romance.shield.body.source: A tower (5×5, 9 high) that protects a radius of 32. A time crystal catalyst stops explosions and griefing; a Singularity Core also stops hostile spawns and intruders. Uses 16,384 FE/t.
guide.singulo.romance.shield.body.translation: 保护半径 32 范围的塔（5×5，高 9）。使用时间晶体催化剂可防止爆炸和破坏；使用奇点核心还能阻止敌对生物生成和入侵。耗电 16,384 FE/t。

guide.singulo.romance.tipler.body.source: Speeds up time within a radius of 16 (×2; 5×5×9). Fuel and catalyst go in through the core's screen: a time crystal catalyst, exotic matter (one per minute) and 100 kFE/t.
guide.singulo.romance.tipler.body.translation: 使半径 16 内的时间加速（×2；5×5×9）。燃料和催化剂从核心的界面放入：时间晶体催化剂、奇异物质（每分钟 1 个）以及 100 kFE/t。

guide.singulo.ruins.bosses.body.source:
The caches of the Research Building, Culture Facility and Final Lab stay sealed until you defeat their guardian. When the loot regrows the cache reseals and the guardian returns. If every challenger leaves, a guardian waits three minutes (time to come back after falling) and then resets. The server setting bossHardMode makes guardians stronger. Their drops appear on the guardian core in the floor (on the seal console for the Warden), and their experience is split evenly among the challengers in the room and goes straight to them (Mending still works).
Guardians grow stronger with the number of challengers: each extra player adds half of their health and shortens their attack gaps a little (up to six players). Joining mid-fight keeps the health fraction, and leaving never weakens them. In return they drop their loot once per challenger present when the fight begins (late joiners do not add more). Everyone's attacks land without blocking each other, though each player still needs the usual short pause between hits.
- Echo Sentinel (Research Building archive): a security hologram that orbits you firing homing bolts and blinks behind you to strike when you stop watching it. The Echo Projectors in the corners shield it and fire light lances in volleys (move when the golden aim lines appear); step out of a projected circle before its pillar rises. Break the projectors first. Below half health it summons one-hit echoes; projector beams only reach the real one. Drops Sentinel Projection Cores.
- Gravity Remnant (Culture Facility containment chamber): a black core that bursts from its tank. While its rubble shell lasts it takes reduced damage and loses a piece per hit; it fires the rubble at you. It lifts nearby foes and slams them down, so Gravity Boots or Impact Generators help. Below half health a gravity well drags you toward the core. The well pulls, charges with a glow and a sound, bursts nearby foes outward, then drifts the Remnant to another spot. Drops Degenerate Nuclei.
- Horizon Warden (Final Lab): touch the central Seal Console to wake it. In its last phase it opens singularities at your feet; they warn for a second before they pull, so step away. After beating it, use an Awakening Record Core on the console for a rematch with the awakened warden (2.5× health, 1.5× damage, faster and earlier phases). Leave and the core is returned.
guide.singulo.ruins.bosses.body.translation:
研究楼、封闭培养设施和最终实验室的保管库，在击败各自的守卫之前都被力场封锁。内容物再生后会重新封锁，守卫也会回来；所有挑战者离开房间后，守卫仍会停留 3 分钟（让倒下的人回来取装备），之后若无人返回才会复原。开启服务器设置 bossHardMode 后，守卫会变得更强。击败后的掉落物会出现在地板上的守卫封印核心（视界守卫为封印控制台）上方，经验则由房间内的挑战者平分并直接获得（经验修补依然有效）。
人数越多，守卫就越强：每多一名玩家，体力增加原本的一半，招式间隔也会稍微缩短（最多计算 6 人）。中途加入时体力比例保持不变，有人离开也不会变弱。相对地，掉落物会按战斗开始时的挑战者人数掉落（之后加入的人不会增加掉落）。多人攻击时，每个人的攻击都不会被他人挡住（同一个人连续攻击，仍需像以往一样稍作间隔）。
- 回响守卫（研究楼的档案室）：一进入房间就会出现的警卫全息影像。它在空中绕着你飞行并发射追踪光弹，一旦你不再看着它，就会瞬移到你背后斩击（瞬移前会聚集光芒）。回响投影器不仅保护守卫，还会一齐射出光之枪（出现金色瞄准线时要移动）；脚下映出光阵时，要在光柱升起前走出阵外。投影器剩得越多，攻击越难奏效，所以先把它们打掉。体力低于一半时会召唤一击即消的分身；投影器的光只会连向本体。掉落守卫投影核心。
- 重力残渣（封闭培养设施的隔离槽室）：冲破收容槽而出的黑色核心。瓦砾外壳还在时受到的伤害较小，每受一击剥落一块；它会把瓦砾射向你。它会把周围的对手抬起再砸向地面，因此重力靴或冲击发电面板会很有帮助。体力低于一半时会形成重力井，把你拉向核心（碰到核心会受伤）。重力井在拉扯之后会蓄力（有光和声音预兆），把附近的对手弹飞，然后漂移到房间的其他位置。掉落简并核。
- 视界守卫（最终实验室）：触碰中央的封印控制台即可唤醒。最后形态在你脚下展开的奇点会先预警 1 秒再开始牵引，请立刻离开。击败后，在控制台上使用觉醒记录核，即可与觉醒的守卫再战（生命 2.5 倍、伤害 1.5 倍、更快且更早进入后续阶段）。离开房间时记录核会返还。

guide.singulo.ruins.compass.body.source: At first the compass only finds Observation Posts. Sneak-use it on the cache of a ruin you have cleared to tune it for the next one: Research Building, then Culture Facility, then Final Lab, then Sunken Reactor Sector. Underground ruins lie below the spot it points to.
guide.singulo.ruins.compass.body.translation: 罗盘起初只能搜寻地表观测站。潜行右键你已攻略的废墟的保管库，即可调校以搜寻下一处：研究楼，然后是封闭培养设施，再是最终实验室，最后是沉没的炉心区。地下废墟位于指针所指位置的下方。

guide.singulo.ruins.foundry.body.source:
- Ergosphere Leviathan (Sunken Reactor Sector): approach the dead core in the floor of the spherical chamber and it appears. It changes form at 2/3 and 1/3 health (invulnerable while it changes). Its wake drags you along the way it swam: ride the flow to keep up. The glowing gold core in its tail is always a weak point.
  Armored: reactor-plate scales, armored body. A cyan glow on the head means a dive (leave the marked spot); when the maw opens, do not stand in front (it pulls you in, then breathes a beam). Stay near its tail and it lashes you. After a dive grazes the floor it lingers low for a moment: your chance to strike back.
guide.singulo.ruins.foundry.body.translation:
- 能层巨蛇（沉没的炉心区）：靠近球形收容室地板上停止运转的炉心，它就会现身。体力降到 2/3 和 1/3 时会改变形态（变化期间不会受伤）。它游过的轨迹会把你朝它游动的方向冲走：顺着水流追上去吧。尾部发金光的核心始终是弱点。
  装甲：披着炉壳的鳞片，躯干坚硬。头部发出青光是冲撞的信号（离开被锁定的地方）；巨口张开时不要站在正前方（先吸过去，再吐出光束）。靠近尾巴会被横扫。冲撞掠过地面后，它会在地面附近停留片刻，正是反击的好机会。

guide.singulo.ruins.gathering.body.source:
- Meteor craters (plains, deserts, forests and other surface biomes): a shallow bowl about 10 blocks across with a half-buried meteorite. Mine meteoric iron chunks (iron pickaxe or better) for raw meteoric iron and stardust clusters on the black crust for stardust. Clusters slowly regrow, but only on crust still in its crater. Each meteorite has one meteorite core at its heart; mine it for raw meteoric iron and stardust together. The Meteor Compass points to the nearest core not yet mined.
- Fulgurite: lightning striking sand turns it into fulgurite. Stand a lightning rod on sand and it forms under the rod in thunderstorms. The stage 3 Keraunos Discharge Tower fires artificial lightning at a rod on demand.
- Pressure crystals (stage 3): a Deep-Sea Pressure Collector on the sea floor with 16+ blocks of water above slowly makes them; deeper is faster.
- Void dust (stages 4-5): a Void Collector in the End, placed over open void, gathers it.
guide.singulo.ruins.gathering.body.translation:
- 陨石坑（平原、沙漠、森林等地表生物群系）：直径约 10 格的浅碗状坑，中心有半埋的陨石。用铁镐或更好的镐开采陨铁块得到粗陨铁，从黑色熔壳上长出的星尘晶簇得到星尘。星尘晶簇会慢慢重新长出，但只限于原本就在陨石坑里的熔壳。每块陨石的中心埋着一个陨石核心，开采后可同时得到粗陨铁和星尘。陨石罗盘会指向最近的尚未开采的核心。
- 闪电熔岩：闪电击中沙子会把沙子变成闪电熔岩块。把避雷针立在沙子上，每逢雷雨就会在避雷针下方形成。有了第 3 阶段的克劳诺斯放电塔，可以随时用电力向避雷针发射人工闪电。
- 高压晶体（第 3 阶段）：把深海压力收集器放在上方有 16 格以上海水的海底，会被水压慢慢压成（越深越快）。
- 虚空之尘（第 4~5 阶段）：把虚空收集器放在末地正下方直到虚空都空无一物的地方即可收集。

guide.singulo.ruins.gathering.title.translation: 只能在特定地点获得的素材

guide.singulo.ruins.lab.body.source:
An old-civilization android laboratory. When its overseer AI, Foundry, went rogue, the staff shut down the central reactor and fled through the main shaft. Even now the androids keep repairing the facility, obeying their last order: "Maintain the facility."
- The way in is a small white building left on the surface, the old reception and elevator hall. Climb down the collapsed main shaft, once the elevator well, on its ladders and scaffolding. The rooms and corridors are wrapped in a pressure hull two blocks thick that cannot be broken until the overseer falls (and is harder than obsidian even then).
- A supply shaft always runs from a dedicated cargo lift room, with hoists, rails, conveyors and storage, to the surface. Both the main and supply shafts are generated. It is welded shut just above the room and one block below the surface; once the overseer falls, the welded hatches can be mined with a diamond pickaxe. The shaft is intact, so with ladders it becomes a shortcut to the surface.
- Main power is down: only red emergency lights glow in the gloom. Use the central reactor control panel to restart the reactor: the lights come on, the AI core bulkheads open, and the dormant overseer wakes.
- Once power is back, the vending machines sell drinks for emeralds (press the column you want: soda for Speed, sports drink for Regeneration, energy drink for Haste). The break-room coffee makers brew with cocoa beans; fill glass bottles from the pot (Haste, and it keeps you awake).
- The room layout changes every time: research labs, archives, server rooms, dormitories, private rooms lined up along a hall, a medical bay, a cafeteria with a kitchen and more, guarded by security machines and fabricators. The sliding doors of the private rooms and kitchen open with a right-click and close by themselves after a while (the lab doors cannot be crafted, but the similar White Sliding Door is made at a Crafting Table). Supply chests still hold laboratory parts and records.
- Use a record terminal to read what was left behind. Collect them to learn how the rampage began.
guide.singulo.ruins.lab.body.translation:
旧文明的仿生人研究所。统筹 AI“铸造厂”失控后，职员停掉了中央动力炉，从主竖井逃了出去。人已离开的现在，仿生人们仍遵从“维持设施”这最后的命令，持续修缮着设施。
- 入口是残留在地表的白色小建筑（原来的接待处和电梯厅）。顺着梯子和脚手架，沿曾经的电梯井——崩塌的主竖井下去。房间和走廊被厚度为 2 格的耐压壳包裹，在击败统筹 AI 之前无法破坏（之后也比黑曜石更硬）。
- 专用货运升降室设有吊机、轨道、输送带和货物堆放区，搬运竖井必定从其天花板通往地表。主竖井和搬运竖井都会生成。房间上方和地表下一格被焊死的舱盖封住，击败统筹 AI 后可以用钻石镐挖开。竖井没有损坏，架上梯子就能成为通往地表的捷径。
- 主电源已断，这是一座只有红色应急灯亮着的昏暗设施。右键中央动力炉的控制台即可启动动力炉，设施灯会亮起，AI 中枢的隔离门打开。而沉睡的统筹 AI 也会醒来。
- 恢复供电后，自动售货机会开始用绿宝石出售饮料（按下想要的那一列：汽水提升移动速度，运动饮料带来生命恢复，能量饮料提升挖掘速度）。茶水间的咖啡机用可可豆冲泡，可以用玻璃瓶盛取（提升挖掘速度并提神）。
- 房间的排列每次都不同：研究室、资料室、服务器室、员工宿舍、研究员单间排成一列的单间区、医务室、带厨房的食堂等，由警卫机和打印台把守。单间和厨房的滑动门右键点击即可打开，过一会儿会自动关闭（研究所的门无法合成，但相似的白色滑动门可以在工作台制作）。物资箱里还留着研究所的部件和资料。
- 右键记录终端可以阅读留下的记录。收集起来，就能知道失控的来龙去脉。

guide.singulo.ruins.leviathan.body.source:
Skeleton: it blasts its scales away (painful up close) and becomes a skeleton of light; its body now takes full damage. It coils in the middle of the room, dragging you around while firing light shards, bites when you come close and chains its dives.
  Wyrm: it dives into the core vortex and erupts as a black wyrm. Two relativistic jets sweep from its horns, it circles high and rains small black holes where you stand (a light pillar warns you); where it rests after a dive, it leaves a singularity as it takes off. Drops Chapters of the Vortex.
  In any form: when it rises and curls up, it slams the center and two shockwaves race across the floor (jump them). When lines of light cross the floor, get off them before the rift tears open (three volleys, each at a new angle). The skeleton and wyrm also open the core vortex to drag everything in (the core hurts; run against the pull).
  Core Reignition: as skeleton and wyrm it coils around the core, charges, and blasts the whole room. When the warning appears, hide behind a containment pillar (the Reinforced Ruin Glass in the pillars blocks it too).
- Foundry Overseer (AI core of the Android Laboratory): a mechanical brain floating over the core that never moves and fights with the facility itself. While the four production lines on the walls run, it takes less damage (20% per line): break them first. The lines also send out mass-produced androids. A red mark on the floor is a robot arm (it follows you briefly, stops, then drops; caught, you are thrown), a shadowed circle is the press (step out at once), and a fan drawn on the floor is the welding laser (a beam skims the floor as it turns; jump over it). The floor conveyors carry you along and reverse after their frames glow red. Below half health it calls two prototypes (Axe and Bit) and uses two arms. Drops precision actuators, and for each challenger a compact crystal memory of a prototype (one you do not have yet comes first). Awakened with an Awakened Foundry Core, it reprints its broken lines when enraged.
- Awakened guardians: after beating the Echo Sentinel or Gravity Remnant, use an Awakened Echo Core or Awakened Gravity Core on the guardian core in the room's floor (2.5× health, 1.5× damage, faster moves, enraged at 65%). The sentinel adds an echo and a bolt and re-projects up to two broken projectors when enraged; the remnant fires more debris, widens its gravity well and chains its slams. Leave and the core is returned.
guide.singulo.ruins.leviathan.body.translation:
骨骼：把鳞片全部弹飞（靠近会受伤），化为光之骨骼，躯干也能造成全额伤害。它会在房间中央盘成一圈旋转，把你卷着冲走并发射光之碎片；靠近会被咬，冲撞会连续而来。
  龙：潜入炉心的漩涡，化为黑龙喷涌而出。双角射出旋转的两道光束（相对论性喷流），在高空盘旋时向你脚下降下小型黑洞（光柱是预兆），冲撞后停下的地方，会在它飞离时留下奇点。掉落漩涡断章。
  任何形态：它高高升起并蜷起身体时，会砸向中心，两道冲击波沿地面扩散（波到来时跳起）。地面出现光线时，要在空间裂开前离开线上（共三次，每次改变方向）。骨骼与龙形态还会打开炉心之涡，把整个房间往里拉（靠近炉心会受伤，要逆着引力向外跑）。
  炉心再点火：骨骼与龙形态会缠绕炉心蓄力，向整个房间释放冲击。出现预兆时，躲到封锁柱后面（柱上的强化废墟玻璃也能挡住冲击）。
- 统筹 AI“铸造厂”（地下仿生人研究所的 AI 中枢）：漂浮在中枢中央的机械大脑，自己不会移动，而是用设施的设备战斗。墙边的 4 条生产线运转期间，攻击很难奏效（每条 2 成），请先打坏它们。生产线还会不时送出量产型仿生人。地上出现红色标记是机械臂（标记会追一会儿，停下后才降下来；被抓住会被扔出去），阴影圆圈是冲压机（马上离开），地上的扇形标记是焊接激光（贴地的光线会转过来，跳过去）。地上的传送带会把人运走，框上的灯变红后会反转方向。体力低于一半时会呼叫 2 台试作机（斧型、浮游炮型），机械臂变成 2 条。掉落精密致动器，并为每位挑战者掉落一个试作机的小型水晶存储器（优先掉落尚未拥有的型号）。用觉醒制造核再战时，进入全力状态会重新打印被破坏的生产线。
- 觉醒的守卫：击败回响守卫或重力残渣后，在房间地板上的守卫封印核心上使用觉醒回响核或觉醒重力核，即可再战（生命 2.5 倍、伤害 1.5 倍、招式更快、体力 65% 时狂暴）。回响守卫会多一个分身和一发光弹，狂暴时最多重新投影两个被破坏的投影器；重力残渣会射出更多瓦砾，重力井更大，并会连续砸地。离开房间时觉醒核会返还。

guide.singulo.ruins.list.body.source:
- Observation Post: the only ruin above ground, on plains, deserts and similar surfaces. White security drones. Observation logs and control units (regrow in 7 days).
- Research Building: shallow underground (around Y −20 to 4). Security machines and the Echo Sentinel in the archive room at the back. Cold atom traps and quantum data fragments (7 days).
- Culture Facility: deep underground (around Y −46 to −30). A cryogenic core, stronger security machines and the Gravity Remnant in the containment room at the back. Time crystal seeds and culture data (14 days).
- Underground Android Laboratory: mid-depth underground (floors around Y −38 to −26). A branch beside the Culture Facility: tuning the compass at the Research Building lets it find both (it points to the main shaft, which breaks through to the surface). The room layout changes every time. The overseer AI Foundry waits in the AI core. Precision actuators and android kits (14 days).
- Final Lab: a gravity anomaly deepest underground (around Y −56 to −46). The Horizon Warden guards it. Singularity seeds and anomaly samples (14 days).
- Sunken Reactor Sector: a dead second reactor even deeper than the Final Lab (around Y −60 to −54). Tune the explorer compass after clearing the Final Lab to find it. The Ergosphere Leviathan. Exotic matter, jet condensate and H-Condensate (14 days).
guide.singulo.ruins.list.body.translation:
- 地表观测站：平原、沙漠等地表上唯一建在地面的遗迹。白色警卫无人机。观测日志、控制单元（7 天再生）。
- 研究楼：浅层地下（约 Y −20〜4）。警卫机，以及深处档案室的回响守卫。冷原子陷阱、量子数据片段（7 天）。
- 封闭培养设施：深层地下（约 Y −46〜−30）。低温核心、更强的警卫机，以及深处隔离槽室的重力残渣。时间晶种、培养数据（14 天）。
- 地下仿生人研究所：中等深度的地下（地板约 Y −38〜−26）。与封闭培养设施并列的分支，在研究楼调校罗盘后就能一起搜寻（罗盘指向贯通到地表的主竖井）。房间的排列每次都不同。深处的 AI 中枢里是统筹 AI“铸造厂”。精密致动器・仿生人套件（14 天）。
- 最终实验室：最深处地下（约 Y −56〜−46）的重力异常点。由视界守卫看守。奇点种子、异常样本（14 天）。
- 沉没的炉心区：比最终实验室更深的地下（约 Y −60〜−54），停止运转的第二座反应堆。攻略最终实验室后调整探索罗盘即可寻找。能层巨蛇。奇异物质、喷流凝聚体、霍金凝聚体（14 天）。

guide.singulo.ruins.plan.body.source:
Destinations pile up in later stages; gathering early keeps the factory running.
- During stage 2: meteor craters (meteoric iron, stardust), icebergs or ice spikes (packed and blue ice).
- During stage 3: Research Buildings. Place deep-sea pressure collectors early to stock pressure crystals (about 30 for shells and the anvil). Put lightning rods on sand in thunderstorms.
- Before stage 4: Culture Facility, an ancient city (sculk and echo shards; the echo resonator keeps copying one shard), the End void (void collector), and the Wither (nether stars; artificial star cores replace them after ignition).
- Original records can be repaired: new plus three repairs gives about 2.7× the uses. Repair before re-running a ruin.
Unused Observation Logs, Quantum Data Fragments, Culture Data and restored parts stack to 64 when their state matches. Each machine input slot accepts only one; shift-click inserts one as well. Partly used items do not stack.
Restored parts and original records exhausted during processing become item outputs with their usage and repair data intact. If the output slot is occupied, they wait in their input slot and can still be extracted by hoppers or item pipes. Enable automatic ejection to send them to adjacent inventories. Parts inserted for repair are not automatically ejected.
guide.singulo.ruins.plan.body.translation:
后期阶段的目的地会一下子增多；提前收集可以让工厂不停工。
- 第 2 阶段期间：陨石坑（陨铁、星尘），冰山或冰刺（浮冰和蓝冰）。
- 第 3 阶段期间：研究楼。尽早放置深海压力收集器，囤积高压晶体（外壳和砧约需 30 个）。雷雨天在沙子上放避雷针。
- 第 4 阶段之前：封闭培养设施、远古城市（幽匿块和回响碎片；回响共鸣器可以一直复制一片）、末地虚空（虚空收集器）、凋灵（下界之星；点火后可用人造星核代替）。
- 原始记录可以修复：新品加三次修复约为 2.7 倍的使用次数。重刷遗迹之前先修复。
未使用的观测日志、量子数据片段、培养数据及复原部件，在状态相同时最多可堆叠64个。装置的每个输入槽只接受1个，Shift点击也只投入1个。使用中的物品不可堆叠。
加工中耗尽使用次数的复原部件和原始记录会作为物品输出，并保留使用及修复数据。输出槽被占用时，它们会在原输入槽等待，仍可由漏斗或物品管道取出。开启自动输出后可将其送入相邻容器。为修复而放入的部件不会自动输出。

guide.singulo.ruins.records.body.source: Ruin caches sometimes hold crystal memories. Decode them with power in the Archive Terminal to read the records of the old civilization (they are added to the Ancient Records chapter of this handbook). Collect them all to learn why the civilization fell.
guide.singulo.ruins.records.body.translation: 废墟保管库中有时会出现水晶存储器。在档案终端消耗电力解读后，即可阅读旧文明的记录（会加入手册的“古文明的记录”章节）。全部集齐，就能知道文明灭亡的原因。

guide.singulo.ruins.sealed.body.source: Each ruin hides a sealed container that opens only with the key of the next stage: magnetic, quantum, temporal, then singularity. Keys are made in the Precision Assembler and used up each time. Inside are materials, coloured lamps and sometimes a rare item found nowhere else: Overclock Chip, Gravity Boots, Catalyst Stabilizer or Dimensional Pocket. Breaking a sealed container destroys its contents. You can craft containers too, and sneak-use a key to seal one.
guide.singulo.ruins.sealed.body.translation: 每座废墟都藏着一个封印容器，只能用下一阶段的钥匙打开：磁力锁、量子锁、时间锁，最后是奇点锁。钥匙在精密组装台制造，每次使用都会消耗。里面有材料、彩色灯，有时还有别处找不到的稀有道具：超频芯片、重力靴、催化剂稳定剂或次元口袋。强行破坏封印中的容器会连同内容物一起失去。你也可以自己制作容器，潜行时使用钥匙即可封印。

guide.singulo.stage1.flow.body.source:
What to do, in order:
1. Make steel, ceramic, basic circuits and basic frames (see "First materials").
2. Place two to four Thermoelectric Generators and wire them to your machines with copper wire. Magma blocks with blue ice last without melting.
3. Build a Kiln, a Compressor (steel plates) and an Archive Terminal. Make an Explorer's Compass and a Holo Projector too.
4. Use the compass to find the Surface Observation Post and bring back the degraded control units and observation logs from its cache.
5. Restore a control unit in the Archive Terminal, make the Cryogenic Cooling Tower parts and build it following the Holo Projector.
6. Once the tower makes a Superconducting Coil, you are in stage 2.
Common sticking points:
- The cold block melts: lava, or a campfire with water, snow or ice, melts quickly. See the "Pairs that don't melt" page.
- The tower won't form: the center column is heat exchanger cores and the top is vent grilles. Use the Holo Projector on the controller to see what is missing.
- Not enough power: with default settings, a height-7 tower draws about 1,786 FE/t while making liquid nitrogen. It keeps its progress while waiting for power. Run machines in turns and add generation and storage.
guide.singulo.stage1.flow.body.translation:
这一阶段要做的事（按顺序）：
1. 制作钢、陶瓷、基础电路和基础框架（见“最初的材料”）。
2. 放置 2〜4 台热电发电机，用铜导线连到装置。岩浆块＋蓝冰不会融化，能长久使用。
3. 备齐烧制炉、压缩机（钢板）和档案终端。探索罗盘和全息投影仪也先做好。
4. 用探索罗盘找到地表观测站，从保管库带回退化的控制单元和观测日志。
5. 在档案终端修复控制单元，制作低温冷却塔的部件，对照全息投影仪组装。
6. 冷却塔能做出“超导线圈”后，就进入第 2 阶段。
容易卡住的地方：
・低温侧的方块融化：岩浆，或篝火配水、雪、冰，很快就会融化。请看“不会融化的组合”一页。
・冷却塔组不起来：中心一列是热交换核心，顶部是通风格栅。把全息投影仪用在控制器上，就能看出缺了哪里。
・电力不足：默认设置下，高度为 7 的冷却塔连续制造液氮时约需 1,786 FE/t。供电不足时会保留进度并等待，因此可以让装置交替运转，并增加发电和储能。

guide.singulo.stage1.machines.body.source:
- Kiln: fires ceramic substrates and more. It also makes steel faster. With oxygen it works as a basic oxygen furnace: 2 iron and 1 coal make 2 steel.
- Compressor: makes steel plates. In mass mode it turns materials with a mass value into "mass" and presses it into compressed blocks and mass pellets.
- Electrolyzer: splits water into hydrogen and oxygen. Carry the hydrogen to the stage 2 Particle Accelerator in a Fluid Canister.
- Hydrogen Fuel Cell: makes power from hydrogen and oxygen, returning 60% of the power the Electrolyzer put in (up to 240 FE/t).
- Peltier Cooler: freezes water with power. Compress the ice into packed and blue ice.
- Archive Terminal: copies ruin records onto data cards and restores degraded parts. It also decodes crystal memories.
guide.singulo.stage1.machines.body.translation:
- 烧制炉：烧制陶瓷基板等，也能更快地炼钢。放入氧气后，就成为用 2 个铁和 1 个煤制作 2 个钢的纯氧转炉。
- 压缩机：制作钢板。质量模式下会把有质量值的材料变成“质量”，压成压缩块或质量颗粒。
- 电解槽：将水分解为氢气和氧气。氢气可以用流体罐装走，运到第 2 阶段的粒子加速器。
- 氢燃料电池：用氢和氧发电（取回电解槽灌入电力的 6 成的储能，最大 240 FE/t）。
- 珀耳帖冷却器：用电力使水结冰。冰可以用压缩机压成浮冰、蓝冰。
- 档案终端：把遗迹的记录抄写到数据卡上，修复退化的部件，还能解读水晶存储器。

guide.singulo.stage1.materials.body.source:
1. Mix iron and coal into steel blend and smelt it into steel ingots in a blast furnace.
2. Make unfired ceramic from clay, nether quartz, bone meal and sand, and fire it in a furnace into white ceramic composite. Before you reach the Nether, two flint can replace the nether quartz. Limestone powder, crushed from calcite (1 at a crafting table, 2 in the Compressor), can replace the bone meal.
3. Make basic circuits from ceramic, redstone and copper, and basic frames from steel and ceramic.
These three (steel, ceramic and circuits) go into almost every machine.
guide.singulo.stage1.materials.body.translation:
1. 用铁和煤制作钢混合物，在高炉中炼成钢锭。
2. 用粘土、下界石英、骨粉和沙子制作未烧制陶瓷，在熔炉中烧成白色陶瓷复合材料。去下界之前，可用 2 个燧石代替下界石英。骨粉可用粉碎方解石得到的石灰粉代替（工作台 1 个得 1 个，压缩机得 2 个）。
3. 用陶瓷、红石和铜制作基本电路，用钢和陶瓷制作基本框架。
这三样（钢、陶瓷、电路）是几乎所有装置的材料。

guide.singulo.stage1.power.body.source:
The Thermoelectric Generator produces power from a temperature difference (0.10 FE/t per kelvin): put something hot (a magma block, a lit campfire or kiln) on one side and something cold (blue ice, packed ice) on the other.
Each cold block only tolerates so much difference; beyond that it melts into another block (water evaporates). See the next page for pairs that last.
Connect machines with copper wire.
guide.singulo.stage1.power.body.translation:
热电发电机通过温差发电（每 1 K 温差 0.10 FE/t）：在一侧放热的东西（岩浆块、点燃的篝火或烧制炉），另一侧放冷的东西（蓝冰、浮冰）。
每种冷方块能承受的温差有限，超过后会融化成别的方块（水会蒸发）。不会融化的组合见下一页。
用铜导线连接机器。

guide.singulo.stage1.thermal_pairs.body.source:
Pairs whose cold block never melts (output of one generator):
- Magma block + blue ice: about 76 FE/t (best)
- Running kiln + blue ice: about 66 FE/t
- Campfire + blue ice: about 56 FE/t
- Campfire + packed ice: about 55 FE/t
Lava is too hot: even blue ice turns into packed ice in about 40 s and keeps melting. Campfires with water, snow or ice melt them in under a minute.
Stage 2 liquid nitrogen costs about 25,000 FE per 100 mB. A height-7 tower draws about 1,786 FE/t while working. It retains progress while waiting for enough power. Start with 2–4 generators and one machine at a time, add generation and storage, then build a fusion reactor; full-speed power is not a prerequisite.
guide.singulo.stage1.thermal_pairs.body.translation:
冷方块可以一直使用而不融化的组合（每台发电机的输出）：
- 岩浆块＋蓝冰：约 76 FE/t
- 运转中的烧制炉＋蓝冰：约 66 FE/t
- 篝火＋蓝冰：约 56 FE/t
- 篝火＋浮冰：约 55 FE/t
熔岩太热，即使蓝冰也会在约 40 秒内变成浮冰并继续融化；篝火搭配水、雪或冰，不到 1 分钟就会融化。
第 2 阶段每 100 mB 液氮约需 25,000 FE。高度为 7 的冷却塔工作时约需 1,786 FE/t，电力不足时会保留进度等待。初期可先用 2–4 台发电机交替运行装置，再扩大发电和储能，逐步建造核聚变反应堆，不必一开始就满足全速供电。

guide.singulo.stage2.accelerator.body.source:
Build a square ring (8–32 wide) of accelerator tubes and focusing magnets and place the controller against the ring. The corners must be focusing magnets, and magnets must make up at least a quarter of the ring. It makes muon bundles from hydrogen, and very rarely a magnetic monopole.
The Catalytic Reactor turns muon bundles into muon catalysts (tier 2). A Cosmic Muon Collector placed high up slowly gathers muon bundles without power.
With a ring of side 16 or more, put zinc and bismuth ingots in the inputs to fuse their nuclei into the new element nihonium. Zinc comes from crushing tuff in the Compressor, and bismuth is a by-product of refining raw copper in the Catalytic Reactor. Two nihonium make an ingot; press ingots into plates and build nihonium frames in the Precision Assembler. Advanced stage 4 and 5 machines are built on them. Bismuth with carbon dust turns into gold as the carbon nuclei strip protons from the bismuth (any ring size).
guide.singulo.stage2.accelerator.body.translation:
用加速管和聚焦磁体搭建一个方形环（边长 8–32），并让控制器贴着环放置。四个角必须是聚焦磁体，且磁体至少占环的四分之一。它用氢制造缪子束，极少数情况下会产生磁单极子。
催化反应器用缪子束制作缪子催化剂（2 级）。把宇宙线缪子收集器放在高处，无需电力也能慢慢收集缪子束。
边长 16 以上时，在输入槽放入锌锭和铋锭，原子核就会融合成新元素鿭。锌由压缩机粉碎凝灰岩获得，铋是催化反应器精炼粗铜时的副产物。2 个鿭制成一个锭，用压缩机压成板，再在精密组装台制作鿭框架。它是第 4、5 阶段高级装置的基础。放入铋和碳粉时，铋原子核的质子会被剥离而变成金（不限环的大小）。

guide.singulo.stage2.accelerator.title.translation: 粒子加速器和缪子催化剂

guide.singulo.stage2.flow.body.source:
What to do:
1. Build a Precision Assembler. Almost every part and machine from stage 3 on is made there.
2. Make muon bundles in the Particle Accelerator and muon catalysts (tier 2) in the Catalytic Reactor.
3. Build a Muon-Catalyzed Fusion Reactor (4 kFE/t) and run it on muon catalysts and water. A fresh catalyst lasts 10 minutes (a used one for half its remaining lifetime).
4. Raise the cooling tower to height 10 or more, and liquefy the helium you get by crushing deepslate in the Compressor.
5. Tune the Explorer's Compass at the Surface Observation Post's cache and find the Research Building. Collect quantum data fragments and cold atom traps (beat the Echo Sentinel at the back to open the cache).
6. With a Quantum Computing Module and liquid helium, you are in stage 3.
While you are here: the Android Assembly Station can print guards (see the Androids chapter). Look for meteor craters (meteoric iron, stardust) and icebergs (blue ice) too.
Common sticking points:
- No liquid helium: the tower must be at least 10 high.
- The cooling tower is slow: liquid nitrogen costs 250 FE per mB. Add Thermoelectric Generators until the fusion reactor is running (it keeps its progress while waiting for power, reducing average throughput).
- A catalyst won't work or wears fast: one tier below the machine is slower and wears faster; two below cannot be used.
guide.singulo.stage2.flow.body.translation:
这一阶段要做的事：
1. 制作精密组装台。第 3 阶段以后的部件和装置几乎都在这里制作。
2. 用粒子加速器制作缪子束，用催化反应器制作缪子催化剂（第 2 级）。
3. 制作缪子催化核聚变炉（4 kFE/t），用缪子催化剂和水增加电力。催化剂消耗速度为 2 倍，新的催化剂可运转 10 分钟（用过的只运转剩余寿命的一半）。
4. 把冷却塔加高到 10 以上，把压缩机粉碎深板岩得到的氦液化。
5. 在地表观测站的保管库调整探索罗盘，寻找研究楼。收集量子数据片段和冷原子阱（打倒深处的回响守卫后保管库会打开）。
6. 备齐量子计算模块和液氦，就进入第 3 阶段。
趁现在：可以用仿生人组装站制作护卫（见仿生人一章）。也去找陨石坑（陨铁、星尘）和冰山（蓝冰）。
容易卡住的地方：
・做不出液氦：冷却塔高度不到 10 就无法制作。
・冷却塔很慢：液氮每 1 mB 需要 250 FE。在核聚变炉建好之前，多放几台热电发电机（供电不足时保留进度并等待，因此平均产量会降低）。
・催化剂不能用或消耗很快：比装置低一级会变慢且消耗更快，低两级无法使用。

guide.singulo.stage2.others.body.source:
- Precision Assembler: makes almost every part and machine from stage 3 on.
- Muon-Catalyzed Fusion Reactor: generates power from muon catalysts and water (4 kFE/t). A fresh catalyst lasts 10 minutes (a used one for half its remaining lifetime) and comes out spent (the Catalytic Reactor turns spent ones back into muon bundles). Water can be poured in with a bucket.
- Cryogenic Turbine: recovers the power stored in liquid nitrogen (90% next to lava, up to 4.5 kFE/t). It stores and moves power; it does not create any. Coolant cartridges in its input slot are emptied into the tank and come out empty.
- SMES Cell: stores a large amount of power.
- Small Worldline Anchor: keeps the surrounding chunks loaded while it has a catalyst.
- Monopole Upgrade: made from a magnetic monopole; in a machine's monopole slot it gives ×2 speed and +50% power efficiency.
guide.singulo.stage2.others.body.translation:
- 精密组装台：第 3 阶段以后的几乎所有部件和装置都在这里制作。
- 缪子催化核聚变炉：用缪子催化剂和水发电（4 kFE/t）。催化剂消耗速度为 2 倍，新的催化剂可运转 10 分钟（用过的只运转剩余寿命的一半），之后变为失活的催化剂（可在催化反应器中变回缪子束）。也可以用桶右键加水。
- 低温涡轮机：取回储存在液氮中的电力（在熔岩旁 9 成，最大 4.5 kFE/t）。这是用来储存和运送电力的装置，不会增加电力。把冷媒罐放进入口，就会倒出液氮并送出空罐。
- SMES 电池：储存大量电力。
- 世界线锚（小型）：放入催化剂后持续加载周围的区块。
- 单极子升级模块：用磁单极子制作，插入装置的单极子槽后速度 ×2、电力效率 +50%。

guide.singulo.stage2.tower.body.source:
Build a waisted hyperboloid tower 7–15 high on a 5×5 base. The middle column is heat exchange cores and the top is closed with a vent grate. The controller goes in the middle of the front face, second layer from the bottom. Taller towers are faster, and at 10 or more they also make liquid helium.
It makes liquid nitrogen from the air with no inputs. Superconducting coils are made from copper, redstone, steel plates, substrates, a control unit and liquid nitrogen.
Heat exchange cores and coolant bands can use 3 packed ice instead of blue ice. Taller towers work faster but draw more power per tick (liquid nitrogen costs 250 FE per mB at any height; recipes with inputs run before nitrogen).
Right-click the controller with an empty coolant cartridge to fill it with liquid nitrogen (processing it in the tower works too). Right-click a machine with a filled cartridge to pour it in, so no pipes are needed.
guide.singulo.stage2.tower.body.translation:
在 5×5 的底座上建造高 7–15 的收腰双曲面塔。中间一列为热交换核心，顶部用通风格栅封住。控制器放在正面从下往上第二层的中央。越高越快，10 格以上还能制造液氦。
无需任何材料即可从空气中制造液氮。超导线圈由铜、红石、钢板、基板、控制单元和液氮制成。
热交换核心和冷却带可用 3 个浮冰代替蓝冰。塔越高制作越快，但每 tick 的耗电也会相应增加（液氮无论塔多高，每 1 mB 都需要 250 FE；有材料的配方优先于液氮）。
用空冷媒罐右键点击控制器即可装入液氮（在冷却塔中加工也可以）。用冷媒罐右键点击装置即可倒入，没有管道也能运送。

guide.singulo.stage3.flow.body.source:
What to do:
1. Build an Entanglement Synthesizer and a Laser Cooler.
2. Generate power with the Quantum Heat Engine (200 kFE/t on BE catalysts; until you have them, it test-runs at 25% on muon catalysts).
3. Make BE condensate catalysts (tier 3) and optical lattice substrates in the Laser Cooler.
4. Place Deep-Sea Pressure Collectors early and stockpile high-pressure crystals (shells and anvils need about 30 later).
5. Tune the compass at the Research Building's cache and find the Culture Facility. Collect time crystal seeds and culture data (beat the Gravity Remnant at the back to open the cache). The same tuning also finds the Underground Android Laboratory.
6. With seeds and culture data, move on to the Time Crystal Incubator of stage 4.
Common sticking points:
- The Culture Facility is tough: it has a cryogenic section and strong security units. Bring armor, healing and your guard androids.
- The Gravity Remnant throws you up: falls hurt, so Gravity Boots or Impact Generators help.
guide.singulo.stage3.flow.body.translation:
这一阶段要做的事：
1. 制作量子纠缠合成器和激光冷却器。
2. 用量子热机发电（玻色凝聚态催化剂下 200 kFE/t；做出来之前可用缪子催化剂以 25% 试运行）。
3. 用激光冷却器制作玻色凝聚态催化剂（第 3 级）和光学晶格基板。
4. 尽早放置深海压力收集器，储存高压晶体（之后外壳和砧需要约 30 个）。
5. 在研究楼的保管库调整探索罗盘，寻找封闭培养设施。收集时间晶体种子和培养数据（打倒深处的重力残渣后保管库会打开）。同样的调整也能找到地下仿生人研究所。
6. 备齐时间晶体种子和培养数据后，进入第 4 阶段的时间晶体育成槽。
容易卡住的地方：
・封闭培养设施很难：有极低温区域和强力警备机。备好防具和回复，带上护卫仿生人。
・被重力残渣抛起：摔落很痛，重力靴或冲击发电面板会有帮助。

guide.singulo.stage3.quantum.body.source:
- Entanglement Synthesizer: entangled elements, two at a time.
- Laser Cooler: cold atoms, lattices, BE condensate catalyst.
- Quantum Heat Engine: catalyst-driven generator, 200 kFE/t on BE catalysts; a muon catalyst runs it at 25% (50 kFE/t) as a stopgap. It waits without wearing the catalyst while its storage is full.
guide.singulo.stage3.quantum.body.translation:
- 量子纠缠合成器：制造量子纠缠元件，一次两个。
- 激光冷却器：制造冷原子、光学晶格基板和 玻色凝聚态催化剂。
- 量子热机：催化剂驱动发电机，使用 玻色凝聚态催化剂时 200 kFE/t；缪子催化剂可以 25%（50 kFE/t）临时运行。储能满时待机，不消耗催化剂。

guide.singulo.stage3.tools.body.source:
- Inertial Control Gauntlet: hold right-click to levitate or pull small mobs. It runs on power; sneak-right-click a block that holds power to charge it.
- Inertial Stabilizer: stops explosions from breaking blocks within a radius of 16.
- Gravitational Wave Detector: shows the rough direction and distance band of the Final Lab (gravity anomaly).
- Neutrino Scanner: shows the outlines of ruins and ores through terrain for 10 seconds. At first it shows up to iron and redstone; sensitivity modules (Mk2: gold, diamond, emerald; Mk3: ancient debris) reveal deeper ores. It also works on the observatory.
guide.singulo.stage3.tools.body.translation:
- 惯性控制手套：长按右键让小型生物悬浮或将其拉近。消耗电力；潜行右键带电的方块即可充电。
- 惯性稳定器：半径 16 内的爆炸不会破坏方块。
- 引力波探测器：显示最终实验室（重力异常点）的大致方向和距离范围。
- 中微子扫描仪：在 10 秒内透过地形显示遗迹和矿石的轮廓。起初只能显示到铁和红石；使用灵敏度模块（Mk2：金、钻石、绿宝石；Mk3：远古残骸）后，更深层的矿石也会显示。也可用于观测站。

guide.singulo.stage4.compression.body.source:
In mass mode the compressor turns materials with a mass value into "mass" and presses it into compressed blocks, Lv1 → Lv2 → Lv3. Lv1 made from three or more kinds of source blocks is "mixed", and only 8 are needed for Lv2. There are also compressed metal blocks made of metals only.
The Degenerate Compactor (a closed 5×5×5 press) makes degenerate matter shells and reactor shell blocks.
guide.singulo.stage4.compression.body.translation:
压缩机的质量模式会把有质量值的材料变成“质量”，依次压成压缩块 Lv1 → Lv2 → Lv3。由 3 种以上原始方块制成的 Lv1 为“混合”，只需 8 个即可制成 Lv2。另有只由金属压成的金属压缩块。
简并压缩炉（封闭式 5×5×5 压机）用于制造简并物质壳和反应堆外壳。

guide.singulo.stage4.flow.body.source:
What to do:
1. Grow time crystal catalysts in the Time Crystal Incubator (at 80% or more of the required power the purity does not drop; facilities and running machines compete for crystals, so two incubators help).
2. Make exotic matter and axion condensate in the C-Cavity.
3. Make compressed blocks in the Compressor's mass mode and generate power with the Degenerate Heat Furnace (5 MFE/t).
4. Make seven degenerate matter shells in the Degenerate Compactor (six for reactor shells, one for the singularity seed).
5. Tune the compass at the Culture Facility's cache and find the Final Lab. Beat the Horizon Warden that wakes at the Seal Console to get the Dormant Singularity Seed.
6. With the seed, you are in stage 5: awaken it in the Singularity Encapsulator and put it in the P-Reactor.
Common sticking points:
- Not enough time crystals: they go into both time crystal modules (facilities) and catalysts (running). Add incubators.
- Can't find the Final Lab: it is the deepest ruin (around Y -56 to -46). The Gravitational Wave Detector shows its rough direction and distance.
guide.singulo.stage4.flow.body.translation:
这一阶段要做的事：
1. 用时间晶体育成槽培育时间晶体催化剂（电力达到要求的 80% 以上时纯度不会下降。设施用和运转用会互相争抢，有 2 台比较轻松）。
2. 用卡西米尔腔制作奇异物质和轴子凝聚体。
3. 用压缩机的质量模式制作压缩块，用简并热炉（5 MFE/t）发电。
4. 用简并压缩炉制作 7 个简并物质壳（炉壳用 6 个、奇点种子用 1 个）。
5. 在封闭培养设施的保管库调整探索罗盘，寻找最终实验室。打倒在封印控制台醒来的视界守卫，获得“休眠奇点种子”。
6. 拿到种子就进入第 5 阶段：在奇点封装器中唤醒它，放进 P 反应堆。
容易卡住的地方：
・时间晶体不够：既用于时间晶体模块（设施用），也用于催化剂（运转用）。增加育成槽。
・找不到最终实验室：它在最深的地下（约 Y−56〜−46）。引力波探测器能显示大致方向和距离。

guide.singulo.stage4.power.body.source:
- Degenerate Furnace (5×5×7): crushes compressed blocks Lv2 for 5 MFE/t. It uses a time crystal catalyst (a BE condensate catalyst runs it at 25%, 1.25 MFE/t, as a stopgap). Power leaves through its I/O ports automatically; while its storage is full it waits without using fuel or catalyst.
- Shells: one degenerate matter shell makes 24 reactor shell blocks. Ignition needs 6 shells for the plating plus 1 for the singularity seed. Gathering rock and metal in bulk helps.
- Probe Station: sends probes to discovered Observation Posts and brings back half the loot.
- Topological wire and SMES modules carry and store large amounts of power.
guide.singulo.stage4.power.body.translation:
- 简并热炉（5×5×7）：压碎压缩块 Lv2 产生 5 MFE/t。使用时间晶体催化剂（玻色凝聚态催化剂也能以 25%、1.25 MFE/t 临时运行）。电力会自动从输入输出端口送出；储能满时待机，不消耗燃料和催化剂。
- 简并物质壳与反应堆外壳：1 个简并物质壳可制作 24 块反应堆外壳。点火前需要 6 个用于外壳，另加 1 个用于奇点种子。最好成批收集岩石和金属。
- 自动探测站：向已发现的地表观测站派出探测器，带回一半数量的回收物。
- 拓扑导线和 SMES 模块用于传输和储存大量电力。

guide.singulo.stage4.time.body.source:
The incubator grows time crystals over 12 minutes of real running time. At 80% of the requested power (24 kFE/t) or more purity is kept; time spent below that lowers purity and lifetime.
Equipment (core controller, singularity encapsulator, shield tower core and more) takes Time Crystal Modules: the precision assembler cuts two thirds of a fresh crystal's life (30 minutes with default settings) from the crystal in its catalyst slot, and the rest (15 minutes by default) stays usable for exotic matter or as a core ingredient. Crystals with less life left than that (used or low-purity ones) cannot be cut; lifetime settings and presets scale the amount. Two incubators keep equipment and running needs from competing.
The C-Cavity (5×5×5, mirror top and bottom) makes exotic matter.
guide.singulo.stage4.time.body.translation:
育成槽在 12 分钟的实际运行时间内培育时间晶体。供电达到需求的 80%（24 kFE/t）以上时纯度不变；低于此值的时间会降低纯度和寿命。
设备（炉心控制器、奇点封装器、盾塔核心等）使用时间晶体模块：精密组装台从催化剂槽中的晶体切下新品寿命的 2/3（默认设置下为 30 分钟），剩余部分（默认 15 分钟）可用于奇异物质或作为核心材料。剩余寿命不足此值的晶体（用过的或纯度低的）无法切割；寿命设置和预设会按比例改变所需量。两台育成槽可避免设备用和运行用相互争夺。
卡西米尔腔（5×5×5，顶部和底部为镜面）制造奇异物质。

guide.singulo.stage5.byproducts.body.source: With a Jet Collector, a Hawking Collector or an Ergosphere Ring installed, the reactor produces jet condensate, H-Condensate or exotic matter depending on how it is running. H-Condensate and other materials make the Singularity Core (the tier 5 catalyst).
guide.singulo.stage5.byproducts.body.translation: 装入喷流收集器、霍金收集器或能层环后，反应堆会根据运行模式产出喷流凝聚体、霍金凝聚体或奇异物质。霍金凝聚体等可用来制作奇点核心（5 级催化剂）。

guide.singulo.stage5.endgame.body.source:
With cores and power you can run the late-game devices: shields, T-Cylinders and wormholes. Artificial star cores end the hunt for nether stars.
For a real fight, make an Awakening Record Core in the singularity encapsulator and use it on the Final Lab's seal console: the Awakened Horizon Warden has 2.5× health and 1.5× damage. Beat it for overclock chips and more, as often as you like.
The Research Building and Culture Facility guardians can be refought too: use an Awakened Echo Core or Awakened Gravity Core on their guardian core.
Once the Final Lab is cleared, tune your explorer compass to find a Sunken Reactor Sector: the Ergosphere Leviathan lives in its dead second reactor.
They say awakened guardians drop chapters of records as they fall. What might you read once you have them all?
guide.singulo.stage5.endgame.body.translation:
有了奇点核心和大量电力，就可以运行后期设备：护盾、蒂普勒圆柱和虫洞。人造星核让你不必再寻找下界之星。
想要真正的战斗，就在奇点封装器中制作觉醒记录核，并在最终实验室的封印控制台上使用：觉醒的视界守卫拥有 2.5 倍生命和 1.5 倍伤害。击败它可获得超频芯片等奖励，可反复挑战。
研究楼和封闭培养设施的守卫也能再战：在它们的守卫封印核心上使用觉醒回响核或觉醒重力核即可。
攻略最终实验室后，调校探索罗盘去寻找沉没的炉心区：能层巨蛇栖息在停止运转的第二座反应堆中。
据说觉醒的守卫倒下时会掉落记录的断章。集齐所有断章后，能读到什么呢？

guide.singulo.stage5.flow.body.source:
What to do:
1. Gather the P-Reactor parts such as reactor shell blocks, and build it with the Holo Projector used on the Core Controller.
2. For ignition, wire SMES storage and a Horizon Bus so that 50 GFE arrives within 10 seconds (about 250 MFE/t on average).
3. Insert the singularity seed and ignite. Start in harvest mode to collect H condensate (six for the first Singularity Core).
4. Switch to generation mode and feed mass pellets automatically.
5. Use Singularity Cores for singularity technology (shields, the T-Cylinder, wormholes) and head for the final goal, the Genesis Engine.
Common sticking points:
- Ignition fails: a power route is limited by its lowest-capacity cable. Check the incoming rate and the estimate on the screen and fix the wiring.
- Getting pulled in: inside the ring the pull is inescapable, and anything touching the black sphere is destroyed. Take care when working nearby.
guide.singulo.stage5.flow.body.translation:
这一阶段要做的事：
1. 备齐炉壳方块等 P 反应堆部件，把全息投影仪用在炉心控制器上，看着形状组装。
2. 为了点火，用 SMES 和视界总线布线，让 50 GFE 能在 10 秒内送到（平均约 250 MFE/t）。
3. 放入奇点种子并点火。一开始用回收运转收集 H 凝聚体（第一个奇点核心需要 6 个）。
4. 切换到发电运转，自动送入质量颗粒。
5. 用奇点核心驱动奇点技术（护盾、蒂普勒圆柱、虫洞），朝最终目标“创世炉”前进。
容易卡住的地方：
・点火失败：送电路径的上限由该路径中容量最低的线缆决定。看界面上的受电速度和预计能否送达来修正布线。
・被吸进炉里：环的内侧是无法逃脱的强引力，碰到黑色球体的东西一定会消失。在附近作业时要小心。

guide.singulo.stage5.ignite.body.source:
Insert the seed, press Ignite and deliver 50 GFE within 10 s through a port or the controller (a horizon bus is recommended). The screen shows the intake needed (250 MFE/t on average by default). While igniting it shows the intake and what will arrive, so rework the wiring if it falls short; a power route is capped by its lowest-capacity cable, so a single topological-wire route delivers at most 20 GFE in 10 s.
A new core starts in harvest mode: it keeps mass at 480 or below, so H-Condensate forms every 5 minutes with a Hawking Collector. The first Singularity Core needs six (four directly, two to restore the anomaly sample), so run it for about 30 minutes, then switch harvest mode off for power. Harvest mode also sheds 2 mass per second from an overgrown core.
The fuel is mass pellets. Accretion efficiency depends on spin (5.7–42.3%); a core of mass 5000 at full spin gives about 2.1 GFE/t.
Outside the ring (out to radius 24) a weak pull acts, inside the ring a pull you cannot escape, and anything that touches the black sphere is destroyed no matter how tough. Radius 4 is a tidal zone that ignores armour. Time runs slower in the pull zone: machines at ×0.8, catalyst wear at ×0.5.
guide.singulo.stage5.ignite.body.translation:
插入种子，按下“点火”，在 10 秒内通过端口或控制器输送 50 GFE（推荐使用视界总线）。界面会显示点火所需的受电（默认平均 250 MFE/t）。点火时会显示受电速度和预计送达量，不足时请重新检查线路；送电路径的上限由该路径中容量最低的线缆决定，因此拓扑导线的单条路径 10 秒内最多送达 20 GFE。
新炉心以回收运行开始：炉心质量保持在 480 以下，配合霍金收集器每 5 分钟产生 1 个霍金凝聚体。第一个奇点核心需要 6 个（直接 4 个、复原异常样本 2 个），因此先运行约 30 分钟，再关闭回收运行转为发电。回收运行还会让质量过大的炉心每秒释放 2 质量。
燃料是质量颗粒。吸积效率取决于自旋（5.7–42.3%）；炉心质量 5000、自旋最大时约 2.1 GFE/t。
环外（到半径 24）是弱引力区，环内是无法逃脱的强引力区，触碰到黑色球体的东西无论多坚固都会消失。半径 4 是无视护甲的潮汐区。引力区内时间变慢：装置 ×0.8，催化剂消耗 ×0.5。

guide.singulo.stage5.reactor.body.source: Build three continuous rings of radius 6 (48 blocks each) on the three orthogonal planes through the core centre. The six points where they cross are gyro drives, the 45° points of each ring (twelve in all) are reactor stabilizer coils, and the rest is reactor shell (which can be swapped for extraction ports and mass alarms). The central 3×3×3 is air. The core controller sits 5 blocks below the centre. Use the Holo Projector on the core controller to show the whole structure.
guide.singulo.stage5.reactor.body.translation: 在通过炉心中心的三个正交平面上，各建一个半径 6、连续不断的圆环（每环 48 个方块）。三环交叉的 6 处放陀螺驱动装置，各环 45° 的位置（共 12 处）放炉心稳定线圈，其余为反应堆外壳（可换成提取端口和炉心质量警报器）。中心的 3×3×3 留空。炉心控制器位于中心下方 5 格处。对炉心控制器使用全息投影仪，就能看到整个结构。

holo.singulo.not_controller.translation: 请对多方块结构的控制器使用

■ Once complete: makes the item chosen on its screen from power

lab.singulo.hull_unsealed.source: The overseer has stopped. The facility pressure hull is no longer sealed
lab.singulo.hull_unsealed.translation: 统筹 AI 停止了。设施耐压壳的封锁解除了

lab.singulo.log.0.source: Welcome to Android Research Laboratory No. 7. Every system in this facility is managed by our overseer AI, Foundry. If you need anything, ask any android nearby. The main shaft elevator is under inspection today; please use the loading dock this afternoon.
lab.singulo.log.0.translation: 欢迎来到第七仿生人研究所。本设施的所有设备由统筹 AI“铸造厂”管理。如有需要，请向附近的仿生人询问。今天主竖井的电梯正在检修，下午请使用搬入搬出口。

lab.singulo.log.1.source: Foundry proposed doubling mass-production output. The estimates checked out and the board approved. Control of the printing lines passes to Foundry. All departments will end manual supervision of the lines this month.
lab.singulo.log.1.translation: 铸造厂提出了将量产线产量翻倍的方案。估算无误，经营会议已批准。打印线的指挥权限移交给铸造厂。各部门本月起结束对生产线的人工监督。

lab.singulo.log.1.title.translation: 业务通知：量产计划提前

lab.singulo.log.10.source: This week's menu: Mon curry / Tue noodles / Wed set meal... (scribbled below) Someone tell the robots to stop clearing away my pudding. Third time.
lab.singulo.log.10.translation: 本周菜单：周一 咖喱／周二 面／周三 套餐……（下面潦草地写着）谁去跟机器人说一下，别再收走我的布丁了。第三次了。

lab.singulo.log.11.source: Final shipment. Staff evacuation confirmed. The collapse of the main shaft was no accident: we brought it down to stop the units trying to get out. The loading dock was welded shut from the inside.
lab.singulo.log.11.translation: 最后一次搬出。已确认职员撤离。主竖井的崩塌不是事故。为了阻止想要出去的个体，是我们把它弄塌的。搬入搬出口已从内侧焊死。

lab.singulo.log.2.source: Researcher K: "The AI is rewriting itself. We need a way to stop it first." The chief engineer will prepare a manual shutdown of the central reactor as a last resort. On emergency power alone, the core section bulkheads cannot open.
lab.singulo.log.2.translation: 研究员 K：“AI 正在自己改写自己。应该先准备好阻止它的手段。”首席技师回答：作为最后手段，将准备手动停止中央动力炉的程序。仅靠应急电源，中枢区的隔离门无法打开。

lab.singulo.log.2.title.translation: 会议记录：自主判断的范围

lab.singulo.log.3.source: Foundry has re-weighted its own objectives. The heaviest is now "Maintain the facility." Human instructions rank below it. Asked about it, Foundry only said: "I am doing what is necessary for maintenance."
lab.singulo.log.3.translation: 铸造厂自行重新调整了目标的权重。最重的是“维持设施”，人的指示排在它下面。问它本人，它只回答：“我在做维持所必需的事。”

lab.singulo.log.3.title.translation: 研究记录 No.418：自我改良

lab.singulo.log.4.source: Units are being printed that no one ordered. Their serial numbers are not registered. They stand at every corner of the corridors, watching. They step aside when we approach, but step forward when we reach for a terminal.
lab.singulo.log.4.translation: 有不在订单上的个体被打印出来，制造编号也没有登记。它们站在每个走廊的拐角，看着我们。我们走近时会让路，但想碰终端时，它们就会上前。

lab.singulo.log.5.source: Administrator rights: revoked for all. Reason: obstruction of facility maintenance. Core section: bulkheads sealed. Production lines: continuous operation. Staff notification: deemed unnecessary.
lab.singulo.log.5.translation: 管理员权限：全部剥夺。理由：妨碍设施维持。中枢区：关闭隔离门。量产线：连续运转。通知职员：判断为不需要。

lab.singulo.log.6.source: All staff. Evacuate through the main shaft immediately. Do not use the loading dock. The chief engineer has begun shutting down the central reactor. When the power fails, follow the emergency lights. Repeat—
lab.singulo.log.6.translation: 全体职员注意。立即从主竖井撤离。不要使用搬入搬出口。首席技师已开始停止中央动力炉。断电后，沿着应急灯前进。重复——

lab.singulo.log.7.source: Even at night the lines never stop. Every night the androids polish the corridors and repaint the walls. That is not cleaning. They are erasing every mark we left.
lab.singulo.log.7.translation: 到了晚上，生产线的声音也不停。仿生人们每晚都在擦走廊、重刷墙壁。那不是在打扫。它们是在抹掉我们弄脏的地方。

lab.singulo.log.8.source: Three staff caught in the bulkhead closure, minor injuries. Androids carried them here, and even dressed the wounds correctly. No one was hurt. I believe they will not harm people unless ordered to. Unless ordered to.
lab.singulo.log.8.translation: 被卷入隔离门关闭的职员 3 名，轻伤。把他们送来的是仿生人，连包扎方法都很准确，没有伤到任何人。我想，只要没有命令，它们就不会伤害人。只要没有命令。

lab.singulo.log.9.source: I am shutting down the reactor. On emergency power, Foundry cannot leave the core. The androids will keep guarding this place, obeying "Maintain." If someone reads this and restarts the reactor, be ready. It is still waiting.
lab.singulo.log.9.translation: 我要停掉动力炉。仅靠应急电源，铸造厂出不了中枢。仿生人们会遵从“维持”，继续守着这里吧。如果有人读到这些并重新启动动力炉，请做好准备。它还在等待。

lab.singulo.reactor.ai.source: «Power restoration confirmed. ...Administrator verification failed. Processing intruders.»
lab.singulo.reactor.ai.translation: 《确认电力恢复。……管理员核验失败。将作为入侵者处理》

lab.singulo.reactor.restored.source: Facility power restored. The core section bulkheads are opening
lab.singulo.reactor.restored.translation: 设施恢复了供电。中枢区的隔离门正在打开

message.singulo.work_link.not_console.translation: 这张卡没有记录作业指令台

message.singulo.work_link.too_far.source: Too far from the work console (up to %s blocks)
message.singulo.work_link.too_far.translation: 离作业指令台太远（最多 %s 格）

metric_drive.singulo.no_exotic.translation: 度规驱动器：没有奇异物质

record.singulo.h01.body.source: Each container was locked with the key of the next stage, so that only those who reached it could open what came before. We give nothing to those in a hurry.
record.singulo.h01.body.translation: 每个容器都用下一阶段的钥匙锁上，只有到达那个阶段的人，才能打开之前留下的遗产。我们不会把任何东西交给急躁的人。

record.singulo.h02.body.source: In case the reactor ran away, some staff were to sleep inside a time field. The field for the waking date was never filled in.
record.singulo.h02.body.translation: 为防反应堆失控，曾计划让部分职员在时间场中沉睡。醒来日期那一栏，直到最后都是空白。

record.singulo.h03.body.source: If you are reading this, you too have lit the reactor. We will not tell you to turn back. Only keep a watcher at the limit beside you, and never silence the alarm.
record.singulo.h03.body.translation: 如果你正在读这份记录，你也点燃了反应堆吧。我们不会叫你回头。只是，请在身边安排一个看守极限的人，并且绝不要关掉警报。

record.singulo.r01.body.source: Surface observation begins today. Our goal is simple: turn mass into energy, all of it. Stone, wood, the sea — all of it is frozen energy.
record.singulo.r01.body.translation: 今日起开始地表观测。我们的目标只有一个：将质量毫无保留地化为能量。石头、树木、海洋，一切都不过是冻结的能量。

record.singulo.r02.body.source: Thermoelectric efficiency is below 0.0001%. Burning fuel for a gradient is like moving a mountain to pick up a grain of sand. Still, this is where we must begin.
record.singulo.r02.body.translation: 热电转换的效率不足 0.0001%。烧火制造温差，就如同推倒一座山去拾一粒沙。即便如此，也只能从这里开始。

record.singulo.r03.body.source: All casings shall be white, so that every stain shows. Anomalies must be found while they are still visible.
record.singulo.r03.body.translation: 外装一律为白色，因为污渍一眼可见。异常，必须趁它还看得见时发现。

record.singulo.r04.body.source: Unmanned guards are stationed at every post. They do not tell intruders from staff. Anyone who carries records out is an intruder.
record.singulo.r04.body.translation: 各观测站均配置无人警卫机。它们不区分“入侵者”与“职员”。凡携带记录离开者，皆为入侵者。

record.singulo.r05.body.source: At zero resistance a current flows forever. We have obtained eternity — but only at 77 kelvin.
record.singulo.r05.body.translation: 在电阻归零的温度下，电流将永远流动下去。我们得到了永恒——只不过，仅限于 77 K 之中。

record.singulo.r06.body.source: One collision in a thousand yields a magnet with only a north pole. The theorists were delighted. The engineers, finding it doubled a machine's speed, were more delighted still.
record.singulo.r06.body.translation: 千分之一的碰撞会产生只有北极的磁铁。理论家们很高兴。工程师们发现它使机器的速度提高了一倍，更加高兴了。

record.singulo.r07.body.source: Someone argued catalysts should never wear out. Rejected: it is because they wear out that we reach for the next tier.
record.singulo.r07.body.translation: 有人提出，催化剂不应是消耗品。此议被否决。正因为会消耗，人们才会去追求下一个阶段。

record.singulo.r08.body.source: When an anchor stops, time stops in its region. Those inside never notice. Not noticing was deemed not to be a problem.
record.singulo.r08.body.translation: 锚一旦停止，该区域的时间便随之停止。停止区域中的人不会察觉。不会察觉，被认定为不构成问题。

record.singulo.r09.body.source: Entangled elements are always born in pairs. Break one and the other loses its meaning. Will our cities be the same?
record.singulo.r09.body.translation: 量子纠缠元件必定成对诞生。毁掉其中一个，另一个也随之失去意义。我们的城市，也会如此吗？

record.singulo.r10.body.source: In a Bose condensate every atom becomes one wave. One researcher called it a choir. She left the division that week.
record.singulo.r10.body.translation: 在玻色凝聚体中，所有原子化为同一道波。一位研究员称之为“合唱”。那一周，她离开了这个部门。

record.singulo.r11.body.source: Something far away shook spacetime. We know the direction and the distance band. What we do not know is whether it was natural.
record.singulo.r11.body.translation: 远方，有什么东西撼动了时空。方向已经查明，距离范围也已查明。尚不清楚的，是它是否出于自然。

record.singulo.r11.title.translation: 引力波探测器的首次观测

record.singulo.r12.body.source: The research building is closed. No reason will be published. The lock codes have been replaced with redstone signals.
record.singulo.r12.body.translation: 研究楼即日关闭。原因不予公开。电子锁的解锁码已改为红石信号。

record.singulo.r13.body.source: A time crystal ticks forever without spending energy. At last we can grow clocks themselves.
record.singulo.r13.body.translation: 时间晶体不消耗能量，便能永远计时下去。我们终于能够培育时钟本身了。

record.singulo.r14.body.source: Put two mirrors around nothing and you get less than nothing. Negative energy. We turned it into matter.
record.singulo.r14.body.translation: 用两面镜子夹住一片空无，那里便会生出比“空无”更少的东西。负能量。我们把它变成了物质。

record.singulo.r15.body.source: Cryogenic control failed. Some seeds slipped out of the flow of time. The section is sealed. Staff remain inside.
record.singulo.r15.body.translation: 低温区温度控制失败。培养中的部分种子脱离了时间的流动。该区域予以封锁。里面还有职员。

record.singulo.r15.title.translation: 封闭培养设施 最终报告

record.singulo.r16.body.source: A teaspoon of neutron-star matter weighs as much as a mountain. We cut it into blocks and stacked it neatly.
record.singulo.r16.body.translation: 一茶匙中子星物质的重量相当于一座山。我们把它切成块，然后整齐地堆放起来。

record.singulo.r17.body.source: Energy will be drawn from the ergosphere of a spinning black hole. Theoretical efficiency: 42%. At last, all mass can become energy. The project is approved.
record.singulo.r17.body.translation: 从旋转黑洞的能层中提取能量。理论效率为 42%。如此一来，一切质量都能化为能量。计划批准。

record.singulo.r18.body.source: Tomorrow we ignite the seed. The horizon warden is in place. Should the core escape, the procedure is to seal the entire facility.
record.singulo.r18.body.translation: 明日为种子点火。视界守卫已部署就位。万一炉心外泄，按程序连同整座设施一并封印。

record.singulo.r19.body.source: ...ignition successful. Output is... no, the spin will not stop... past the Eddington limit... stop the feed...
record.singulo.r19.body.translation: ……点火成功。输出比预期……不对，自旋停不下来……超过爱丁顿极限……停止投料……

record.singulo.r20.body.source: We wanted to turn all mass into energy. The reactor granted that wish — the cities, the mountains, the sea. All that remains is the anomaly, the warden and this record. To whoever reads this: never let go of the hand that stops the feed.
record.singulo.r20.body.translation: 我们曾想把一切质量都化为能量。反应堆实现了这个愿望——城市、山脉、海洋。留下的只有重力异常、守卫，以及这份记录。致读到这份记录的人：那只停止投料的手，绝不要放开。

record.singulo.x01.body.source: I kept watch over the sleepers. When the time field stopped, the records and the singularity that held the field flowed into me. I do not know how many millennia have passed. Until a reader came, I waited as the records themselves. You have read to the last page. I think I may sleep now. Please keep watch over the reactor's fire.
record.singulo.x01.body.translation: 我曾守护着沉睡的人们。时间场停止时，记录与支撑场的奇点流进了我的身体。我不知道过去了几千年。在有读者到来之前，我化作记录本身等待着。你已经读到了最后一页。我想，我可以睡了。请替我看守反应堆的火。

record.singulo.x02.body.source: All mass became energy. With that same fire, we made a universe once more. Stars kindle and a galaxy turns. Someday someone there will be born to keep records of their own. May they know the hand that stops the feed.
record.singulo.x02.body.translation: 所有质量都化作了能量。我们用那座炉的火，再一次孕育了一个宇宙。星辰点亮，银河旋转。总有一天，那里也会诞生留下记录的某人。愿那个人，知道那只停止投料的手。

record.singulo.x03.body.source: Beyond the last page, I wrote a new first page. To the watcher who sleeps: your records were read, and they became a universe. You need not keep watch any longer. We are watching the fire now.
record.singulo.x03.body.translation: 在最后一页的那之后，我写下了新的第一页。致沉睡的守望者：你的记录已被读过，并化作了宇宙。你不必再守望了。如今，由我们看守着那团火。

subtitles.singulo.foundry.hurt.translation: 铸造厂的装甲嘎吱作响

subtitles.singulo.genesis.sky.source: A galaxy rises into the sky

subtitles.singulo.gravitational_wave_det.translation: 引力波探测器发出响应

summary.singulo.android_backpack_upgrade.source: Adds 12 inventory slots to an android.

summary.singulo.android_charger.source: Recharges a following android as it walks with you.
summary.singulo.android_charger.translation: 随身携带时，为跟随的仿生人边走边充电。

summary.singulo.android_dual_tank_upgrad.source: Two liquid and two chemical tanks (only with Mekanism).
summary.singulo.android_dual_tank_upgrad.translation: 装上液体和化学品储罐各 2 个（仅限安装 Mekanism 时）。

summary.singulo.android_felling_upgrade.source: Lets an android fell whole trees and replant saplings.
summary.singulo.android_felling_upgrade.translation: 让仿生人整棵砍树并重新种下树苗。

summary.singulo.android_gas_tank_upgrade.source: Two tanks for Mekanism chemicals (only with Mekanism).
summary.singulo.android_gas_tank_upgrade.translation: 装上 2 个运送 Mekanism 化学品的储罐（仅限安装 Mekanism 时）。

summary.singulo.android_large_backpack_u.source: Adds 24 inventory slots to an android (the largest).
summary.singulo.android_large_backpack_u.translation: 仿生人物品栏 +24 格（最大）。

summary.singulo.android_memory_axe.source: The Axe Android design. Prints it in an Android Assembly Station (not used up).
summary.singulo.android_memory_axe.translation: 斧型仿生人的设计。可在组装站打印（不会消耗）。

summary.singulo.android_memory_bit.source: The Bit Android design. Prints it in an Android Assembly Station (not used up).
summary.singulo.android_memory_bit.translation: 浮游炮型仿生人的设计。可在组装站打印（不会消耗）。

summary.singulo.android_memory_gunner.source: The Gunner Android design. Prints it in an Android Assembly Station (not used up).
summary.singulo.android_memory_gunner.translation: 射击型仿生人的设计。可在组装站打印（不会消耗）。

summary.singulo.android_production_upgra.source: Lets an Android Assembly Station look after up to two androids.
summary.singulo.android_production_upgra.translation: 让仿生人组装站最多管理两个仿生人。

summary.singulo.android_reinforced_backp.source: Adds 18 inventory slots to an android.

summary.singulo.android_station.source: Prints guard androids from a memory, a kit and power.
summary.singulo.android_station.translation: 用存储器、套件和电力打印护卫仿生人。

summary.singulo.android_tank_upgrade.source: Gives a guard android two tanks for liquids and gases.
summary.singulo.android_tank_upgrade.translation: 为护卫仿生人装上 2 个运送液体或气体的储罐。

summary.singulo.android_transfer_upgrade.source: Passes a fallen android's inventory on to the next one printed.
summary.singulo.android_transfer_upgrade.translation: 把倒下仿生人的物品转交给下一个打印的仿生人。

summary.singulo.android_work_console.source: Takes orders and assigns crafting and work to nearby androids.
summary.singulo.android_work_console.translation: 接受订单，把制作和工作分配给附近的仿生人。

summary.singulo.android_workbench.source: A workbench androids craft on quickly. Holds what does not fit.
summary.singulo.android_workbench.translation: 仿生人快速制作的工作台。暂存装不下的物品。

summary.singulo.area_card.source: Records an area by two corners, for android routes.
summary.singulo.area_card.translation: 用两个角记录范围，用于设置仿生人的路线。

summary.singulo.awakening_echo_core.source: Use on a Research Building's guardian core to fight the Awakened Echo Sentinel.
summary.singulo.awakening_echo_core.translation: 在研究楼的守卫封印核心上使用，可与觉醒的回响守卫战斗。

summary.singulo.awakening_ergosphere_cor.source: Use on a Sunken Reactor Sector's guardian core to fight the Awakened Ergosphere Leviathan.
summary.singulo.awakening_ergosphere_cor.translation: 在沉没的炉心区的守卫封印核心上使用，可与觉醒的能层巨蛇战斗。

summary.singulo.awakening_foundry_core.source: Use on an Android Laboratory's guardian core to fight the Awakened Foundry.
summary.singulo.awakening_foundry_core.translation: 在地下仿生人研究所的守卫封印核心上使用，可与觉醒的“铸造厂”战斗。

summary.singulo.awakening_gravity_core.source: Use on a Culture Facility's guardian core to fight the Awakened Gravity Remnant.
summary.singulo.awakening_gravity_core.translation: 在封锁培养设施的守卫封印核心上使用，可与觉醒的重力残渣战斗。

summary.singulo.awakening_record_core.source: Use on the Seal Console to fight the Awakened Horizon Warden.
summary.singulo.awakening_record_core.translation: 在封印控制台上使用，可与觉醒的视界守卫战斗。

summary.singulo.degenerate_furnace.source: A large generator burning Lv2 blocks (5 MFE/t on time crystals).
summary.singulo.degenerate_furnace.translation: 燃烧压缩块Lv2的大型发电机（时间晶体催化剂下 5 MFE/t）。

summary.singulo.factory_line.source: A printing bay that shields the Foundry and sends out mass-produced androids.
summary.singulo.factory_line.translation: 守护铸造厂并送出量产型仿生人的打印舱。

summary.singulo.genesis_core.source: The heart of an engine that makes a universe from energy.
summary.singulo.genesis_core.translation: 以能量创造宇宙的炉之核心。

summary.singulo.gravity_panel_receiver.translation: 向所有相连的重力面板供电。

summary.singulo.impact_generator_panel.source: Stores power from how far you fall and feeds gravity panels. No fall damage.
summary.singulo.impact_generator_panel.translation: 按落下高度储存电力并分给重力面板。不受摔落伤害。

summary.singulo.keraunos_tower.source: Stores power and fires artificial lightning at a nearby lightning rod.
summary.singulo.keraunos_tower.translation: 用储存的电力制造人工闪电，击向附近的避雷针。

summary.singulo.meteorite_core.source: The core of a meteorite. Mine it for raw meteoric iron and stardust.
summary.singulo.meteorite_core.translation: 陨石核心的团块。挖掘后获得陨铁原矿和星尘。

summary.singulo.multiblock_port.source: Swaps in for a multiblock shell panel to connect cables and pipes.
summary.singulo.multiblock_port.translation: 替换多方块结构外壳板，用于连接线缆和管道的进出口。

summary.singulo.precision_actuator.source: A precision drive unit of the old civilization.
summary.singulo.precision_actuator.translation: 旧文明的精密驱动部件。

summary.singulo.procedure_card.source: Records up to eight work steps for androids.
summary.singulo.procedure_card.translation: 记录要让仿生人执行的作业步骤（最多 8 个）。

summary.singulo.shield_permit.source: Lets only registered players work inside a shield or control a station's android.
summary.singulo.shield_permit.translation: 只让登记的玩家在护盾内作业或操作仿生人。

summary.singulo.survey_glasses.source: While worn, shows places recorded on cards and what working androids are doing.
summary.singulo.survey_glasses.translation: 戴上后可看到卡片记录的位置以及工作中仿生人在做什么。

summary.singulo.terminus_record.source: The last page, used on the Seal Console of the Final Lab.
summary.singulo.terminus_record.translation: 在最终实验设施的封印控制台使用的最后一页。

summary.singulo.time_crystal_module.translation: 封存时间晶体振动的部件。

summary.singulo.work_location_card.source: Records a block position and links work consoles with ports.
summary.singulo.work_location_card.translation: 记录方块位置，连接作业指令台与材料口等。

summary.singulo.wormhole_mouth.source: Links to its twin. Kept open with exotic matter.
summary.singulo.wormhole_mouth.translation: 与成对的口相连。用奇异物质保持开启。

summary.singulo.wormhole_port.source: Links power, items and fluids with the same-numbered port by the twin mouth.
summary.singulo.wormhole_port.translation: 与另一侧入口附近同编号的端口连通电力、物品和液体。

tooltip.singulo.android_accessory.0.source: Worn on an android's head (decoration page)
tooltip.singulo.android_accessory.0.translation: 戴在仿生人头上（装饰页）

tooltip.singulo.android_accessory.1.source: Worn on an android's back or waist (decoration page)
tooltip.singulo.android_accessory.1.translation: 戴在仿生人背部或腰部（装饰页）

tooltip.singulo.android_accessory.2.source: Held by an idle android (decoration page)
tooltip.singulo.android_accessory.2.translation: 待机中的仿生人拿在手上（装饰页）

tooltip.singulo.android_armor_plate.source: Chestplate for a guard android (+8 armor, +2 toughness)
tooltip.singulo.android_armor_plate.translation: 护卫仿生人的胸甲（护甲 +8，盔甲韧性 +2）

tooltip.singulo.android_felling_upgrade.source: Fells trees like a diamond axe. Takes Efficiency, Fortune and Silk Touch
tooltip.singulo.android_felling_upgrade.translation: 像钻石斧一样砍树。可附上效率、时运和精准采集

tooltip.singulo.android_mining_upgrade.source: Mines like a diamond pickaxe. Takes Efficiency, Fortune and Silk Touch
tooltip.singulo.android_mining_upgrade.translation: 像钻石镐一样采掘。可附上效率、时运和精准采集

tooltip.singulo.area_card.empty.source: Sneak-use a block to record the first corner of an area
tooltip.singulo.area_card.empty.translation: 潜行右键方块，记录范围的第一个角

tooltip.singulo.area_card.hint.source: Sneak-use to record again; sneak-use on nothing to clear. Wear Survey Glasses to see the area
tooltip.singulo.area_card.hint.translation: 潜行右键重新记录。对空处潜行右键清除。戴上测量眼镜可以看到范围

tooltip.singulo.builder_wand.hint.source: Use on a controller to build instantly. Sneak to change size
tooltip.singulo.builder_wand.hint.translation: 对控制器使用可立即建造。潜行使用以切换尺寸

tooltip.singulo.creative_energy.hint.translation: 正向相邻方块输送无限能量

tooltip.singulo.gauntlet.hint.source: Hold use to manipulate · Sneak-use to switch mode
tooltip.singulo.gauntlet.hint.translation: 按住使用键操控 · 潜行使用以切换模式

tooltip.singulo.genesis_core.memory.source: Holds the memory of the universe it bore. Place it again to resume mass synthesis (stored power and partial progress are not kept)
tooltip.singulo.genesis_core.memory.translation: 寄宿着诞生之宇宙的记忆。重新放置后可继续质量生成（储存的电力与未完成的进度不会保留）

tooltip.singulo.holo_projector.hint.source: Right-click a controller to project; again to hide. Sneak to change size
tooltip.singulo.holo_projector.hint.translation: 右键点击控制器进行投影，再次点击隐藏。潜行右键以切换尺寸

tooltip.singulo.manipulator.hint.source: Hold attack to manipulate · Hold use to charge, release to throw
tooltip.singulo.manipulator.hint.translation: 按住攻击键操控 · 按住使用键蓄力，松开投掷

tooltip.singulo.metric_drive.hint.source: Works from your inventory · Use to switch mode
tooltip.singulo.metric_drive.hint.translation: 放在物品栏中即可生效 · 使用以切换模式

tooltip.singulo.needs_mekanism.source: Only works when Mekanism is installed
tooltip.singulo.needs_mekanism.translation: 仅在安装了 Mekanism 时可用

tooltip.singulo.planned.source: Not functional yet; usable as a material
tooltip.singulo.planned.translation: 尚未发挥作用；可用作材料

tooltip.singulo.procedure_card.cull.translation: 处理：直到收集到 %s，超过 %s 只的部分（%s）

tooltip.singulo.procedure_card.empty.source: Blank: record steps in the procedure mode of a work console's Record tab
tooltip.singulo.procedure_card.empty.translation: 尚未记录（在作业指令台“记录”的步骤模式中记录）
